marinas.name: Harborside Hotel & Marina
marinas.about: The Harborside Hotel ,Spa and Marina is one of the only Bar Harbor resorts with its own marina. Located just minutes from Acadia National Park, our downtown marina features floating docks that can accommodate vessels from 40 to 165ft in length along with a variety of marina services. (Listed in Profile) While docked at our marina, you and your passengers will also enjoy full access to the Harborside's exceptional hotel amenities. ( Listed in Profile) Marina Contact #'s 207-801-7024 207-801-3904 207-288-2386

marinas.name: Dockside Inn & Tavern Marina
marinas.about: Dockside Inn and Tavern is located on the edge of pristine Moosehead Lake in down town Greenville, Maine. The marina has 12 lakeside slips offering both seasonal and short term dockage from May 15th through October 15th. On site at the Inn, you will find several spacious suites that provide ample accommodations and spectacular views overlooking grand Moosehead Lake. Our Dockside Tavern is open year round and provides great food, spirits, and fun! Our team at Dockside Inn and Tavern will aim to make your visit a memorable one.

marinas.name: Lyman-Morse
marinas.about: Located in the heart of Camden Harbor, Lyman-Morse is a full-service destination for boaters. Our recently modernized facility features 900 feet of deep-water face dockage and upgraded slips, capable of accommodating vessels ranging from day sailors to 200-foot superyachts. Guests have access to a comprehensive set of amenities, including high-speed Wi-Fi, a crew lounge, courtesy car, launch service, bicycles, day offices, and private showers. The property features excellent on-site options, including the Salt Wharf Restaurant & Rooftop Bar and Barren’s Distillery. We are also centrally located just steps from downtown Camden, giving you immediate access to local shops, cultural attractions, and hiking trails. Whether you are here for a seasonal stay or a transient stop, Lyman-Morse Camden provides a convenient, high-quality home base on the Maine coast.

marinas.name: Boothbay Harbor Oceanside Resort Marina
marinas.about: The Boothbay Harbor Oceanside Resort has it all - wonderful waterfront accommodations and Maine’s mid coast at your doorstep. Located at the water’s edge, our resort offers spectacular harbor views of picturesque Boothbay Harbor. Join us by land or by sea – we offer premier waterfront docking. All of our rooms and suites have been updated with an air of casual elegance, king-size beds, and luxury linens.

marinas.name: Hinckley Yacht Services - Northeast Harbor
marinas.about: Our Northeast Harbor yard is ideally situated for cruising boaters with access to many local restaurants (both casual and formal), provisioning services, tennis courts, showers, laundry facilities, fuel, and pump-out services, while offering slips for vessels up to 80 feet along with a complete service and repair yard onsite. Although our Northeast Harbor facility does not offer any moorings, instead, refer to our Southwest Harbor yard, which is a quick 10 minute cruise by water.

marinas.name: Coveside Restaurant & Marina
marinas.about: Coveside Restaurant Fall hours are: CLOSED SUNDAY-TUESDAY , open Wednesday/Thursday 4:00 pm-8:30 pm, Friday/Saturday 11:30 am-9:00 pm. Music in the Burgee Bar Saturday nights 8:00 pm-11:00 pm. Closing for the season on Saturday, September 27 Christmas Cove, located between Boothbay and Pemaquid Point in the picturesque village of South Bristol, was named for Captain John Smith when he anchored here, December, 1614. Coveside Restaurant & Marina offers a gorgeous setting, along with dock and mooring space in the safety of Christmas Cove. Enjoy a delicious meal on the deck overlooking the sailboats, or in our spacious dining room offering a spectacular view from every seat in the house. The Burgee Bar is a sailor's delight with ragged colorful burgees brought in from all over the world, hanging from the rafters. If you have the opportunity, the Sunday Dockside Parties from 2-5 pm are a favorite event for locals and travelers alike! Dockside parties are known for their fantastic live music

marinas.name: Atlantic Boat Company
marinas.about: Atlantic Boat Company is dedicated to providing the highest quality services for our customers. From the most simple, routine maintenance to the construction of new boats built to order, our customers can count on Atlantic Boat Company to complete their projects with conscientiousness and expertise. Looking for a convenient and affordable location to launch your boat? Atlantic Boat has an easily accessible boat launch ramp and a marina with both seasonal moorings and transient moorings for rent. And, when the time comes let Atlantic Boat haul your boat out of the water and store it in one of our indoor or outdoor storage locations.

marinas.name: Belfast Marina
marinas.about: A privately owned marina in Belfast, Maine. Providing boaters access to one of the most beautiful seaside villages on the East Coast. Boaters can enjoy a protected harbor and fantastic dining and shopping downtown. Brand new wave attenuating docks (2021)

marinas.name: Fore Points Marina
marinas.about: Fore Points Marina graciously accommodates vessels of all sizes with first class hospitality and full-service amenities. Nestled in a protected safe harbor, you will be surrounded by scenic Casco Bay and just steps away from the Old Port’s exciting culinary scene, boutique shops, and activities. The gated marina is professionally staffed at all times providing you and your crew with any essential or luxury desired to make your short or extended stay delightful! Fore Points Marina is an Ocean Havens property - www.oceanhavens.com

marinas.name: Tenants Harbor Boatyard
marinas.about: Tenants Harbor Boatyard, situated on the coast of Maine, is equipped with a modern 10,000 square foot building capable of handling all aspects of boat repair and storage, with year-round marine fuel available. The yard provides full-service to both local and visiting yachtsmen for mechanical, rigging, metal fabrication, electronics, canvas and upholstery, and haul-out up to 25 tons. An attractive destination and cruising center, the working waterfront of Tenants Harbor offers close proximity to air transportation, car rental service, Internet access, many fine restaurants, inns and supply stores. The yard makes a great location for crew changes and a base for provisioning. Many have found Tenants Harbor in St. George to be the perfect landfall for boats coming from Boston and the Cape and the perfect gateway to the best parts of Maine.

marinas.name: DiMillo's Kennebunk Marina
marinas.about: DiMillo's is proud to announce we have opened our second location in the beautiful town of Kennebunk. Only steps away from some of the finest restaurants and shops in downtown Kennebunkport, our marina is ideal for all boaters looking to make the most of these gorgeous towns. With enough dockage to accommodate vessels up to 85 feet comfortably, our Kennebunk Marina is very easy to access once in the river.

marinas.name: Chicks Marina
marinas.about: Kennebunkport is a destination worthy of its memorable trip, and for 56 years, Chicks Marina has been synonymous with boating on the Kennebunk River. Founded by local icon Booth Chick and owned and operated by the Katz family for 37 seasons, Chicks’ goal is to provide you with the highest level of service from the moment you make your reservation until the time you depart. Chicks is just a short walk from Dock Square, the center of Kennebunkport’s historic seaport community. While in town, you will find unique shops, galleries, and other attractions. There are dozens of restaurants within a short distance from the marina and various nearby sandy beaches. Our first-class facilities are the finest in Maine and are continuously upgraded to ensure your stay is safe, pleasant, and memorable. Chicks offer transient dockage, seasonal summer slips, and heated indoor winter storage. marinas.name: Safe Harbor Rockland
marinas.about: Safe Harbors Rockland, offers a suite of amenities supported by our unparalleled customer service. This gated facility provides transient and seasonal dockage in a protected basin for vessels up to 200 feet. We in addition have 14 transient moorings in which we can accommodate vessels ranging from 30'-70'. Our mooring field is located approximately 1/3 of a mile from our docks. A full service restaurant, sandy beach, spotless showers, water, electricity, internet, complimentary laundry, courtesy SUVs and many more options to make your stay incredible. Plus everything this thriving town has to offer - from art galleries, to incredible shops and restaurants, it's just steps away via our Harbor boardwalk to downtown. We are just five minutes away from a small airport that gives you access to a quick commuter flight. marinas.name: Handy Boat Service
marinas.about: Welcome to Falmouth, Maine’s largest anchorage and home to Handy Boat Service since 1934. Our members enjoy season after season of sailing and boating on beautiful Casco Bay. With the convenience of being less than 15 minutes from Maine’s largest city Portland, Maine, and a full service boat yard and marina without the commercial traffic and bustle of the city. For our cruisers stopping in for a shorter stay Handy Boat has over 50 transient mooring rentals for boats up to 80’ and dock space available, our launch service, full service boatyard, Dockside Provisions convenience store, fuel, ice and of course The Dockside Grill restaurant. All of our amenities are available to our seasonal and short term customers to make Handy Boat a can’t miss for boating in southern Maine.

marinas.name: Derecktor Robinhood
marinas.about: Note: Fuel sales by appointment only from November 1 to May 1. Please call at 207 371-2525 Derecktor Robinhood is the only commercial enterprise on picturesque Riggs Cove, an exceptionally clean and quiet harbor. Osprey and harbor seals share our secluded anchorage with some of the coast’s most experienced yachtsmen. While we’re constantly upgrading and improving our facilities, there’s also a strong sense of tradition at Robinhood. Some of our waterfront buildings date back to late 1700′s. We pride ourselves in offering state of the art yacht services in a simple New England village setting. Slips, moorings, storage and complete yacht services are available.

marinas.name: Tremont Town Dock
marinas.about: Tremont Town Dock is a municipal marina with 160’ of floating dock, serving boaters in the Bass Harbor area. Looking for something to eat? Just a short walk from our docks, Thurston's Lobster Pound serves fresh-caught Maine lobster. If you want to explore during your stay, we are a 10 minute drive to Bass Harbor Head Lighthouse. Due to our close proximity to the heart of Acadia National Park, a wide variety of hiking trails are also available within a short drive.

marinas.name: Sebasco Harbor Resort
marinas.about: We are open and looking forward to welcoming you! Overnight moorings are available at $65 per night from Sunday through Thursday, and $80 per night on Fridays and Saturdays. Just visiting for the day? We offer complimentary moorings for day use when you purchase a meal at The Ledges Pub. We are offering two seasonal packages for 2025: Seasonal Mooring Rental for $2,500/season or Seasonal Dock/Dinghy Access for $900/season Both packages entitle you to use of our Fitness Center including Showers and Restrooms. The packages also give you access to our Saltwater Pool, Tennis & Pickleball Courts, Bicycles, and Trash Disposal. See you on the water!

marinas.name: Hodgdon Yacht Services - Southport
marinas.about: America's oldest boatbuilder is now a leading Maine service provider with locations in the Boothbay region. Hodgdon Yacht Services offers a complete range of waterfront facilities, including slips, moorings, fuel dock, free pumpout, provisioning, outboard motor dealerships, marine electronics, and other marina amenities in midcoast Maine. ​We're proud to offer certified inboard, Diesel, and outboard mechanics, Yamaha outboard motor dealership, Suzuki outboard motor dealership, Highfield RIB dealer, inboard and outboard service and repair, electronics work, carpentry and joinery, rigging, Awlgrip paint, composite repairs, inside heated, unheated, and outside boat storage, gas and diesel fuel, a fully stocked ships store, 55-ton Travelift, and more on one of the most beautiful and protected spots on Maine's coast. Fuel dock open 7 days a week through Labor Day.

marinas.name: Hodgdon Marina
marinas.address: 85 McFarland Point Dr, Boothbay Harbor, ME 04538
marinas.about: An ideal stopover point when heading east from Portland is Hodgdon Marina in Boothbay Harbor. Located on the quiet side of the harbor - yet still within walking distance of downtown's restaurants, galleries, and shops - the facility provides at the dock depths ranging from 8-18 feet, 750 linear feet of space, gas and diesel fuel, 30-, 50-, and 100-amp hookups, and full marina amenities. The spacious venue has the capacity to accommodate large sail and power boat fleets for comfortable socializing both on and off the water. Mobile boat repair is available, and extensive projects can be catered to by Hodgdon Yacht Services, a full-service boatyard. Currently offering fuel Monday - Friday, seven days a week Memorial Day - Labor Day.

marinas.name: Causeway Marina
marinas.about: Causeway Marina offers some of the best deep water slips in the area. Protected from winds, tucked between brandy pond and long lake. Just a minutes' walk to local restaurants and activities. Causeway Marina can accommodate boats up to 50' in length! Shore power, water and cable TV are all available! Other amenities include private sandy beach with swim area, full bathroom with shower, kitchen, pump out service, 120' fuel dock with Regular and Premium Valvtec Fuel. Certified technicians and expert dock staff available 7 days a week. Emergency haul out available is also available 7 days a week. Visit our services page for a full list of things we offer!

marinas.name: Yankee Marina & Boatyard
marinas.about: Yankee Marina & Boatyard, a family-owned, full service marina, is in its 4th decade of providing the highest quality marina services to serious boaters living near or visiting the scenic coast of Southern Maine and around the world. Yankee Marina, places integrity as its highest priority in servicing customers. When partnering with you to maintain, repair, or improve your boat, we are committed to providing solid technical consultation and maintaining an ongoing dialogue to ensure that we meet your needs, budget and schedule to the best of our ability. In achieving this goal, our staff views their responsibility personally for ensuring your safety and satisfaction. Through this approach, we build the enduring, trusting relationships that enable our customers to rely on us year after year.

marinas.name: Yarmouth Boat Yard
marinas.about: Yarmouth Boat Yard is located on the Royal River with easy access to Maine’s Casco Bay. A full-service marina with fuel and 110 slips, YBY accommodates boats up to 46 feet. They cater to ocean-going powerboats and provide full maintenance, repair, and storage services as well as boat sales.

marinas.name: Brown's Wharf Motel & Marina
marinas.about: Brown’s Wharf Inn & Marina is a family owned and operated marina, hosting mariners since 1944. Located on the quieter side of Boothbay Harbor with only a 15-minute walk via the footbridge to the center of town. We are in between two restaurants, each only a 5-minute walk, and many more restaurants are available in town. Brown’s Wharf Inn also offers 70 hotel rooms, all with a water view and balcony. Full marina amenities include 24-hour bathrooms, showers and laundry facilities. On-site parking is available if you bring your car. During the day, there is a trolley available that will take you to town and the supermarket. The Harbor offers shopping, galleries, antiques, a wide variety of dining experiences, a movie theatre, scenic boat tours and the famous Coastal Maine Botanical Garden's and much more. During the day, there is a trolley available that will take you to town and the supermarket.

marinas.name: Mason Station
marinas.about: About Mason Station Redevelopment Company LLC, a Joint Venture between Treadwood, LLC and North Light Energy LLC, was formed to explore options for the adaptive reuse of the former Mason Station coal/oil power plant in Wiscasset on the banks of the Back and Sheepscot Rivers in Mid-Coast Maine. While still early in the concept development stage, the site offers features that make it a strong candidate for redevelopment into a low-impact, renewable energy campus and marina. Mason Station can showcase the best of Maine ingenuity and an example of the mutual benefits possible when climate initiatives partner with fisheries and the working waterfront.

marinas.about: About Downeast Yacht Services, LLC offers secure indoor and outdoor storage at three locations in Penobscot, ME. From commercial fishing boats and marine equipment to sailing and recreational vessels we have over six acres and 15,000 square feet of clean, level storage for all types and sizes. Combined with our trucking and service departments we offer a complete winter storage solution for your boat or marine related project. Whether you have a lobster boat, picnic boat, center console, day sailor, offshore cruising sailboat, racing sailboat, fishing boat - we have your off season boat storage needs covered - Literally!

marinas.name: Bristol Marine at The Shipyard in Boothbay Harbor
marinas.about: The Shipyard in Boothbay Harbor, formerly Sample’s Shipyard, was founded in 1869. Continuing local shipbuilding tradition, the yard specializes in the maritime skills and trades that made New England famous. Its 700-ton marine railway has braced tall ships, superyachts, tugboats, fishing trawlers, Coast Guard vessels and other service craft such as passenger boats and ferries. The 150-ton railway has accommodated sailing yachts, workboats, schooners and motor vessels. The 6,000-sf climate controlled service bay is equipped with a state-of-the-art humidification system to keep wooden hulls from drying out. A low-dust environment is ideal for yacht-quality varnishing and painting. A deck-level mezzanine creates efficient working conditions for staging equipment and materials. The Shipyard offers seasonal & transient moorings during the summer season and winter storage for those needing to keep their boat safe and sound for the winter months. marinas.about: Awards About Long Beach Marina is a quaint, family-owned marina that has been on Sebago Lake for over 30 years. It’s roots can be traced back as far as 1947, when employees started the tradition of writing their names and the years of summers worked at the marina on the boat house walls. Since our family purchased the marina in 1988, we strive to provide customers with the same memorable, enjoyable experiences that the family has enjoyed for years. We've had the pleasure of providing our customers with personalized service, many of whom continue to come back to the marina year after year. Our marina offers convenient and hassle-free ski boat, pontoon boat and mooring rentals to those looking to enjoy all that a Maine summer has to offer. We work to keep intact the original charm of the marina while continually modernizing its offerings to boaters and vacationers. marinas.name: Sunset Marina
marinas.about: Enjoy reliable, affordable dockage and prime location at Sunset Marina. A full-service marina with daily and seasonal dockage in Portland Harbor. Sunset Marina is conveniently located with phenomenal skyline views and gorgeous sunsets. We offer a Fuel dock, Ship Store, High Speed Wireless Internet, Restaurant on site and 150+ full service slips. Downtown Portland is a short dinghy or water taxi ride across the harbor. We are committed to providing you a relaxed marine experience. Book your 2026 slip now as Transient and Seasonal slips sell out quickly ! We have a few seasonal slips available for the 2026 season. Please contact the marina through Dockwa, via email at info@sunsetmariname.com or by calling 207-767-4729.

marinas.name: South Port Marine
marinas.about: South Port Marine is a well-maintained Full Service marine facility with Haul/Launch capabilities of up to 55 Tons and over 170 wet slips that can accommodate yachts up to 150′ with drafts of up to 8′ at MLW. We offer year-round storage options, both wet and dry, as well as indoor boat storage in our new indoor storage building. Lowest Fuel Prices in Casco Bay. We are located just across the Casco Bay Bridge from Portland’s historic Old Port district, just minutes from the Portland International Jetport. Both public & private transportation services are available at the marina, including the 24 hour Atlantic Water Taxi. With multiple restaurants, private fishing charters available (such as Teazer Charters and Casco Bay Custom Charters) and numerous grocery/shopping options on or just steps from our docks, South Port Marine is your one stop recreation facility.

marinas.name: Spring Point Marina
marinas.address: 1 Spring Point Drive, South Portland, ME 04106
marinas.about: Spring Point Marina is Maine’s largest full-service marina. With over 250 slips, Spring Point can accommodate yachts up to 200 ft. in length. The marina is conveniently located at the entrance of Portland Harbor, in walking distance to beaches and lighthouses, a short taxi ride to Downtown Portland, and only 5 miles from the Portland Jetport.

marinas.name: Smugglers Cove Inn
marinas.address: 727 Ocean Point Road, East Boothbay, ME 04544
marinas.about: Smuggler’s Cove Inn is a hidden gem in a sheltered cove in Linekin Bay, East Boothbay, Maine. This seaside inn has its own private beach and a heated salt-water swimming pool. The restaurant on site, 727 Ocean Sunset Bar is available for breakfast, happy hour or dinner. Four moorings, located to the right of the Smuggler’s Cove Inn dock in Linekin Bay, are available for short term or overnight stays. Moorings are available for up to 40' boats (please check mooring capacity). Overnight Rate: $50 per night per mooring in the shoulder season and $55 per night over summer. Hotel guests may hire moorings for $25 per night. marinas.name: Maine Yacht Center
marinas.about: Maine Yacht Center is well protected from prevailing summer breezes. Our floating concrete breakwater provides excellent protection from the east and from any ocean swells or wind-generated waves. Our 100 slips and 300' of "along-side" tie-up can accommodate yachts up to 150'. Maine Yacht Center's guest facilities provide for all the needs of the visiting yachtsman. Inside you'll find clean bathrooms and showers, laundry facilities, kitchen, a comfortable lounge with wonderful views of Casco Bay, and a store with ice, basic supplies, snacks, and refreshments. Please contact our dockmaster for more reservations and information.

marinas.name: Paul's Marina
marinas.about: Paul's Marina is a family owned and operated marina in the heart of Casco Bay. We are easily accessible by boat or kayak and offer transient moorings as well as seasonal moorings. You can find us by car or bike via the Mere Point Road in Brunswick, Maine. We pride ourselves by treating all of our patrons and guests like family. On premise you can find Judy's General Store which offers freshly made cookies and muffins, sandwiches made to order, Gifford's Ice Cream, penny candy, and the Mainely Made Gift Shop full of island apparel and goodies locally made. We also provide an active fuel dock, often offering the best-priced gas on the bay. We receive shipments from Hamilton Marine twice a week for all your boating accessory needs. We provide contracted servicemen available for all your basic boating or motor repairs. Additionally, we have a crane on the wharf for lifts, launches, and repairs.

marinas.name: Jonesport Shipyard
marinas.about: Jonesport Shipyard is a welcome stopover between Mount Desert Island and Canada, located in a well-protected cove on Moosabec Reach in Jonesport, Maine. We offer two moorings in the NW corner of Sawyer Cove to accommodate transient boats up to 40-feet and 6-feet draft. We also have 5 moorings outside the breakwater that will accommodate boats to 60-feet. Locals and cruisers alike turn to the Shipyard for expert service, repair, maintenance and storage. Our dinghy dock is available to mooring guests. It has a depth of 7-feet at mean high tide and is dry at low. Inside you will find a friendly place to rest with clean showers, laundry, and marine supplies. marinas.name: Hinckley Yacht Services - Southwest Harbor
marinas.about: Hinckley Southwest Harbor is at the heart of the Hinckley legend. It began in 1928 as a small service yard and today ranks as a world-class builder of sailing yachts. Hinckley Southwest Harbor yard attracts a local, national, and international community of yachtsmen who want their boats to have the highest level of care and service. As one of eight boat repair facilities Hinckley Southwest Harbor can assure its customers that no matter where they cruise on the east coast, boat repair work done in Southwest Harbor is recognized and backed by the company’s facilities from southern New England to Florida. Our season begins June 15th. The dock will be staffed Monday-Friday 8am-4pm.

Whether it is for winter storage or a summer slip, Journey’s End offers the amenities to keep your boating experience comfortable and fun. Whether you want us to take complete care of your vessel from bow to stern, or just a portion of your maintenance needs, we offer reasonable rates and a staff that is ready to welcome you into a long term service relationship. marinas.about: Great Cove Boat Club is a small association of sail and power boat enthusiasts who dock our vessels at our marina in Eliot, Maine, just upriver from Portsmouth, New Hampshire. Founded in 1988, we have approximately 89 slips and 14 moorings. The Club strives to support maritime interests and the community in general. Toward this end, we offer transient moorings and slips to visiting boaters when available. Our cove off the busy Piscataqua River offers easy access to Portsmouth Harbor, Great Bay and the Atlantic coast. Markets, restaurants and a pharmacy are all within six miles, and the marina is served by the Portsmouth Water Taxi service. Our moorings have floating, 2-sided docks making tie-up easy.

marinas.about: Boothbay Harbor Yacht Club (BHYC) in mid-coast Maine has been celebrating yachting for over 125 years, welcoming boaters who want to experience the fabled Downeast cruising grounds and picturesque Boothbay Harbor. We have guest moorings available - up to 4,500 lbs. Mooring fees are $50 per night for vessels up to 55 feet. Water and electricity are available at the dock. The dockside depth is 14 feet at low tide. We're a short taxi ride into town, or a 1.3-mile walk. Our club stewards provide launch service from the Club's docks during the season, generally from 0900 hrs. to sunset (more limited hours early and late season). Visitors have access to the Club's dining room and bar, wi-fi network, showers, coin-operated laundry, and on-site post office. BHYC is home to over 300 members and families and is the perfect destination for visiting sailors. With extensive guest moorings and a full-service clubhouse, BHYC hosts both individual yachts and affiliate clubs with ease.

marinas.name: The Marina at Harbour Place
marinas.about: Portsmouth is a great walking city and this location puts you at the heart of the waterfront. The marina docks lead right onto Bow Street in the city center which is truly a pleasure to visit. Downtown Portsmouth is rich with history, arts, entertainment and numerous restaurants and pubs.The city is a destination in and of itself. Your slip is a great place to watch the commercial ships and tugboats pass by as the sun sets over historic Badger’s Island, Maine’s southernmost point. Marina at Harbour Place is just passed the new Memorial Bridge, which can be reached on VHF Channel 13, or wait for the preplanned opening every half hour during the daytime. Please note the current is strong here. But, it is parallel to the docks so if you just stem the current, even a beginner can make a perfect landing every time. For the easiest approach do not attempt to dock with a following current. If you are able, plan to arrive during slack tide.

marinas.name: Prescott Park Municipal Dock
marinas.address: Prescott Park, Marcy Street, Portsmouth, NH 03801
marinas.about: Publicly available docking space is available at Prescott Park on the Piscataqua River in Portsmouth. Reservations are possible. The dock is governed by city ordinance. The dockmasters monitor VHF Channel 09, and notice of arrivals is requested. List of amenities below may be nearby and not specifically on site. Dock space may be reserved by the hour, you will need to request the amount of time. Limited 30 amp spaces are available, you will need a 30 to 50 amp splitter for other slips. Docking on the cement docks require a 4 hour minimum fee. PLEASE NOTE: DUE TO REPAIRS: For the remainder of the 2025 summer we only have one slip available with power and water. All other slips rentals will have to be on the wooden north docks without power and water.

marinas.name: Great Bay Marine
marinas.about: About Great Bay Marine, Inc.: Celebrating 70 years — Great Bay Marine is New Hampshire Seacoast’s only year-round, full-service boating facility. Located six miles up the Piscataqua River on 36 acres, we serve Portsmouth, Newington, and surrounding communities. The marina has nearby shopping, tennis, and golf. We are located within an hour’s drive of major airports, including Boston's Logan, Portland (Maine,) Manchester (New Hampshire,) and nearby Pease Air and Tradeport in Portsmouth. marinas.about: Safe Harbor Wentworth by the Sea, the ultimate in comfort and service, is nestled in the heart of Little Harbor. Just moments away from open ocean cruising, we offer deep water docks with accommodations for vessels up to 200 ft. Our professional and friendly staff will greet you at your slip upon arrival and cater to all of your needs. Enjoy lunch and dinner at Great Island Eatery's fantastic dock side location (603) 559-1006. Or experience the two other restaurants on site at the Wentworth by the Sea hotel. We are also conveniently located just minutes from historic downtown Portsmouth with award winning restaurants, shops, and entertainment. Passing time comes easily at Safe Harbor Wentworth by the Sea.

marinas.name: Hyannis - Gateway Marina
marinas.about: Gateway Marina is a small marina and is town owned; located in the village of Hyannis. The Marina is situated in Hyannis Inner Harbor and is a short walk from main street Hyannis. It can accommodate smaller vessels up to 25 feet. Harbormaster staff is not on location 24/7. You can request assistance and we will respond if available VHF09 or 508-790-6273. The majority of the slips are contract with a few transients for visitors. The Marina offers water and electricity along the bulkhead. The is a quite Marina with minimal wake, wind impacts due to its location. Transient parking passes are available for transient bookings. Parking abuts the Marina slips.

marinas.name: Whaling City Moorings
marinas.about: Moorings are located in the Pope's Island Mooring Field South located just east off the channel, between Red Nuns 6 & 8 and south of Pope's Island Marina. Mooring balls are white with a green stripe.

marinas.name: Vineyard Haven Moorings
marinas.about: Martha's Vineyard, known for it's crystalline green shores, Atlantic breezes, fabulous shops, eateries and pubs, scenic and historic towns - and Vineyard Haven Marina is known for the numerous amenities and privacy it ensures its guests. Our deep water moorings and dockage can accommodate vessels up to 250 feet in length. Vessels over 60 feet looking for transient moorings should hail on the radio when entering the harbor. The marina will arrange shore side accommodations, dining reservations, special Island tours, and air or ground transportation, to name a few. Come to Vineyard Haven Marina: we're here to make your Vineyard visit an experience that will exceed your expectations! 2 night minimum in July & August All moorings are on the outside of the break-wall. Launch service is seasonal and is provided separately by Vineyard Haven Launch Service, please contact them directly for hours and dates of operation.

marinas.name: The Harborside Inn Docks
marinas.about: The Edgartown Harbor is one of the busiest harbor's on the East Coast, home to some of the world’s most beautiful yachts and sailboats. The Harborside Inn provides dockage which for lunch and overnight reservations, as well as for Harborside Inn owners and seasonal slip holders. Dockmaster's Office: During peak season we are on duty from 8:00 am until 6:00 pm. 508-627-4321 ext. 117. VHF Channel 10. Please Be Advised: We currently DO NOT OFFER SHORE POWER, however the use of generators is allowed. All reservations must be made through Dockwa. Please confirm your reservation 24 hours prior to your scheduled arrival and hail on VHF Channel 10 when entering the harbor. We can accommodate most yachts up to 140', at the Dockmaster's judgement. marinas.name: Vineyard Haven - G and B Moorings and Launch
marinas.about: MOORING RENTALS: We have 12 transient moorings located in the first two rows closest to the breakwater in the outer harbor (on the outside of the breakwater). Availability from June 26th through October 14th. Our moorings are the white, conical shaped mooring balls with a blue bottom marked “Rental” with a little yellow reserve polly ball. Accepting Reservations via Dockwa OR in person on a first-come-first-serve basis. Cash/Check ONLY for first-come-first serve rentals. NO inner harbor moorings. NO dockage/slips. NO rafting of vessels. PLEASE HAIL “the Vineyard Haven Launch Service” upon your approach on VHF Channel 72. TRANSIENT MOORING RENTAL RATES: Overnight - $70 / Half Day (4 hours) - $30 LAUNCH SERVICE: Operating from June 28th to September 2nd 2025. Launch service to and from the inner and outer harbor is available seven days a week, payable by CASH or CHECK only to the launch driver. You can enjoy waterfront views while you enjoy some of the best dining our lovely town has to offer.

marinas.name: Mattapoisett Boatyard
marinas.about: Full service boatyard in the heart of Buzzards Bay. We are family owned and operated since 1962. We service all makes and models of engines including Yanmar, Westerbeke, Volvo, Cummins, Caterpillar, Universal, Beta and Detroit. We also handle Yamaha, Suzuki, Evinrude, Nissan, Tohatsu outboards. We handle all types of sail and power vessels from daysailers to 50' yachts. We specialize in varnish, fiberglass repairs, all aspects of detailing, cleaning, restoration, repowering. We are fully staffed to handle all aspects of rigging, mechanical repairs and maintenance, outboards, inboards. No job is too small. We are known for our quick repairs during the mid-season so you can get back on the water quickly knowing the job is done right! Mattapoisett Harbor is centrally located on Buzzards Bay, approx. 10 miles across to Woods Hole (an easy beam reach), away from cape Cod so no traffic. marinas.name: The Marina at Hingham Harbor
marinas.about: The Marina at Hingham Harbor is a private, deep-water facility nestled at the head of Hingham's Inner Harbor, and just steps from historical downtown Hingham. The Marina offers dockage for seasonal and transient recreational boaters. The 46-slip marina has water and offers an array of convenience products and services for its mariners. Our slips are an extension of a large wharf which provides more than ample parking for boaters and guests. For interest in membership, please open the apply now form and fill out the membership information. The Marina at Hingham Harbor is also a corporate apparel reseller of Helly Hansen merchandise. Please visit our online store at www.marina26.com

marinas.name: Chilmark Harbormaster (Menemsha Harbor)
marinas.about: Welcome to Menemsha Harbor. Our aim is to uphold a well-organized, secure, respectful, and family-friendly marina experience. Menemsha Harbor is open to both recreational boaters and commercial fishermen. The village's historic harbor is a departure point for local fishermen, many of whom come from fishing backgrounds that span multiple generations. In addition to booking a trip with one of our Charter Fishing Captains, visitors can enjoy the public beach near the harbor, take the bike ferry across Menemsha Pond to Aquinnah, and savor freshly prepared seafood at various dining establishments. The area is renowned for its stunning sunsets. We offer two transient moorings inside the harbor that can accommodate up to three (sometimes four) sailboats. Just outside the breakwater in the outer harbor, there are eight single-occupancy moorings available for sailing or power vessels. If you have a sailboat and require a mooring, we will assign one inside the harbor by default unless specified

marinas.name: Gloucester Harbormaster
marinas.about: The City of Gloucester, through the harbormaster's office, rents 30 transient / visitor moorings for vessels up to 60 feet. They are located in the following three areas: -The Inner Harbor, where the day-to-day hustle and bustle of a working waterfront can be enjoyed, is in close proximity to downtown shops and restaurants. -The Southeast Harbor offers views of the mansions of Eastern Point, sunsets over the Western Harbor and the Boston skyline in the distance. -The Western Harbor, off of Stage Head, is where the original settlers landed and dried fish. The harbor offers a beautiful view of downtown church steeples and the City Hall tower. The Gloucester Harbor Launch is free of charge with your reservation and can be contacted on VHF channel 72 or by phone - 978-726-0155

marinas.name: Pamet Harbormaster
marinas.about: The harbormaster maintains a few transient moorings inside the harbor. There is no room to anchor inside the harbor. Call for availability.

marinas.name: Boston Harbor Islands: Peddocks Island
marinas.about: One of the largest islands in Boston Harbor, Peddocks Island offers miles of trails, unique geologic features, and the remains of historic Fort Andrews. The island is dotted with colorful cottages that serve as private residences during the summer months. We ask that all visitors be mindful of the residents and their privacy. The park is open from dawn until dusk. Reservations are available for both daytime and overnight use. Please note that pets are not permitted in the park. To find more information about park regulations and activities, please visit bostonharborislands.org.

marinas.name: Hyannis - Bismore Park Marina
marinas.about: Bismore Park Marina is located in the village of Hyannis. Commercial and Recreational vessel traffic occur at this marina. Bismore is located in the heart of Hyannis and is an easy walk to the downtown area. Pump-out shore side facilities are on location and operational May 25 through Oct 7. Water and electrical are also available. The marina has artist shanties and two restaurants on location. The marina has fixed piers! Harbormaster staff is not on location 24/7. You can request assistance and we will respond if available VHF09 or 508-790-6372. The marina has public bathrooms open in-season however, there are no shower facilities. The marina is staffed into the evening/overnight during the summer months. Security patrols the slips at night. Parking is limited and requires payment however, we can provide a temporary parking pass if you book a slip. Call Marina staff on VHF 9 upon approach. Cell Phone number is (508) 294-1450 Bismore Park Marina office (508) 790-6372 Main office HM off

marinas.name: Goodwin Creek Marina
marinas.about: About Goodwin Creek Marina can best be described as a second home on the Merrimack. Visit any weekend between Memorial Day and the end of September and you are likely to find a higher percentage of boats occupied than would be the case downriver at one of Newburyport’s many fisherman’s marinas. Actually, you are likely to find more boats, period. Goodwin Creek’s boat owners love being on the water in their boats, but figure that the body of water where their slips are located is at least as attractive as any other, so why move. Even when they leave their slips, the 20 miles of navigable Merrimack River offers all that most of them desire on the water. Upstream to the west is quiet green-lined New England river. Downstream to the east, the river becomes busier, wider, deeper and downright exciting at the mouth. About five miles downstream, Newburyport offers one of the northeast’s most appealing ports of call. Goodwin Creek Marina also boasts an in ground swimming pool and heads and sho

Long Point Marina is located in Historic Provincetown Harbor. Offering seasonal slips (May-September) docking for vessels from 35 to 140 ft. A short walk to the center of town. Known for its unique shops, restaurants, theater, whale watching, art galleries, and nightlife. We celebrate Diversity, Arts, and Culture. The public bathrooms are in close proximity to our Marina. Diesel fueling is available for berthed vessels via tanker truck. No on-site shower facilities or restrooms. 24/7 site supervision.

marinas.about: Spectacle Island features moorings for reservation. The Moorings are located on the north side of the main pier and can be reserved on the Dockwa app or on Dockwa.com. The Marina has been dismantled for this season due to taking damage over the winter. We are hoping to get the Marina back online in the future. Drop off/pick up is still permitted when the ferry is not there, Long tie-up is not permitted at this time. Part of the Boston Harbor Islands National and State Park, Spectacle Island spans 105 acres and provides multiple attractions. Along with five miles of walking trails, the island features a visitor center, swimming beach, and breathtaking, 360 degree views of Boston and the surrounding islands. The park is open from dawn until dusk, with facilities open during ferry operating hours. Reservations are available for both daytime and overnight use. marinas.name: Safe Harbor Sunset Bay
marinas.about: Celebrated sunsets, renowned beaches, and easy access to the Boston Harbor Islands make Safe Harbor Sunset Bay a one-of-a-kind coastal urban oasis. Just minutes from Boston’s city center, opportunities for adventure and relaxation are abundant. Take a peaceful walk on the spectacular Nantasket Beach, enjoy a brew with a view at one of our waterfront restaurants, or day trip to the famed islands rich with possibilities for outdoor recreation.

marinas.name: Battleship Cove Moorings
marinas.about: The City of Fall River offers several daily transient moorings, within the Battleship Cove, at a rate of $36.50 per day. Enjoy a day exploring the best of Fall River while spending the night alongside the historic Battleship Cove. Whether it’s a family adventure aboard the world’s largest collection of historic naval ships, a visit to the nearby marine museum and carousel, or an evening out at one of the area’s many restaurants, local theaters or art galleries, there’s no shortage of entertainment just minutes from the waterfront. With the ongoing revitalization of the city’s waterfront district, there’s even more to look forward to. -Mooring Information: • Moorings are red and white, clearly marked by letter. • A dinghy dock is available at the southern end of the mooring field, located between the ship and the carousel. • Mooring assignments and gate codes will be sent through Dockwa once assigned. • If needed, you may also request information via Dockwa “Messages” or by contacting t

marinas.name: Fan Pier Marina Boston
marinas.about: Fan Pier is located in the Seaport neighborhood of Boston. This area is Boston's new hottest neighborhood with restaurants, shopping, and arts and culture - all walkable from the marina. Dine at over 50 restaurants with cuisines from around the world, explore The Institute of Contemporary Art (ICA), shop at LL Bean, enjoy a game of pool at Kings, take in a movie at Alamo Drafthouse, or just savor the incredible views of Boston from your boat. This Marina expanded in 2020 and now offers a variety of berthing options including protected slips, dockage space, stern to dockage moorings to accommodate mega yachts, and hourly tie-up space when available. The marina is home to a floating amenities barge with showers and restrooms. Just across the harbor is Harbor Energy, the premier fuel dock in Boston that also offers in-slip fuel delivery via their traveling barge. marinas.name: Great Harbor Yacht Club
marinas.about: About Our marina offers dock space for Members and their guests, either seasonally or as transient visitors. The Great Lady, GHYC’s Crosby launch, delivers sailors to their boats and to our fleet of Rhodes 19s moored in the harbor. Club-owned kayaks and paddleboard provide Members an excellent opportunity to explore nearby creeks and the beautiful Monomoy coastline.

marinas.name: Brandt Cove Marina
marinas.about: Brandt Cove Marina is located in the extremely well protected Brandt Island Cove in Mattapoisett, MA. Formerly, Leisure Shores Marina, we operate a family oriented, professionally run 75 slip marina. Slips range from 17 – 45 feet with power and water available. The central location on Buzzards Bay makes this an ideal spot to access some of the best cruising and fishing grounds in the world! Martha’s Vineyard, Nantucket, Cuttyhunk, Newport, Falmouth, New Bedford, and the Cape Cod Canal are all nearby destinations. Secluded harbors, beaches, and small towns are all within easy reach. Getting here is easy and there is no Cape traffic! Brandt Cove Marina offers full marine service for all makes and models of boats. All service work is provided by Mattapoisett Boatyard located on Ned’s Point Road in Mattapoisett Harbor. Our technicians are set up to perform all aspects of maintenance and repairs at either location. We service most major engines including Yanmar, Cummins, Caterpillar, Volvo,

marinas.name: Nantucket Moorings
marinas.about: We have 125 moorings available in Nantucket Harbor and we can accommodate boats up to 85' in length. In high season (July & August) between the hours of 8am - 4pm, call us (Channel 68 VHF) as you approach the Brant Point lighthouse and we will meet you and escort you to your reserved mooring. If arrival time is after 4pm prior arrangements need to be made. Advance reservations are encouraged, however transient visitors may be accommodated on a first come/first served basis. We offer nightly rates. Please Note: July 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th are all subject to 3-night minimums. All other dates for 2025 are subject to a 2-night minimum. This means that no matter if you select one night, the minimum night charge requirement will still apply. For Customers of Nantucket Moorings - Launch Details - Nantucket Launch Company offers launch services along with charters and tours. Please visit their site for details and accommodations: https://nantucketlaunch.com/

marinas.name: Town of Wareham Harbormaster - Onset Harbor Transient Moorings
marinas.about: Welcome to Onset Harbor and the Victorian seaside community that overlooks it. Vessel fuel, Yacht Club, full service marinas, Dining, groceries, laundry and the post office are all within walking distance of the Onset Village Town Pier and within Onset Harbor. The Wareham Harbormaster is responsible for the Towns transient moorings that can welcome vessels up to 50’ and 7’ draft. Complimentary launch service is available to vessels staying on the towns transient moorings when the launch is in operation. There is also a public pier and dock available for vessels to pull in as well as a dinghy dock. The fixed pier bulkhead is available to vessels from 50’ to 110’ and can accommodate vessels with up to 9’ draft. Vessels are not to be left unattended for extended periods of time.

marinas.name: Bare Cove Marina
marinas.about: Located in beautiful Hingham Harbor, Bare Cove Marina offers easy access to great fishing, sailing, and cruising. Just steps away from historic Hingham Center, location of South Shore's best restaurants and wonderful shopping. Our 40 boat slips provide plenty of dock space in Hingham Harbor for vessels up to 35 feet. Slips are complete with fresh water, and electricity...and the rates are affordable. For your convenience, we now have an online reservation form. Bare Cove Marina is a full service facility offering boat slips and mooring services. We offer a 12 hour launch service with access to over 100 moorings in Hingham's Inner Harbor. Our mooring service operates two mooring barges and two workboats to ensure the best and most timely mooring services available.

marinas.name: Boston Harbor Islands: Georges Island
marinas.about: Georges Island is home to historic Fort Warren, one of Boston's premier historic sites for Civil War-era history. Visitors can explore the fort's graceful granite archways, or catch stunning views of the Harbor and Boston Light from the ramparts. The island also features shade shelters and picnic areas with scenic water views. Georges Island features two mooring areas, with options to moor close to Georges Island or across the channel adjacent to Gallops Island. The views from the Gallops mooring field of Ft. Warren are spectacular. Please note that Gallops Island is closed to public access. The park is open from dawn until dusk, with facilities open during ferry operating hours. Reservations are available for both daytime and overnight use. Please note that pets are not permitted in the park. To find more information about park regulations and available activities on the island, please visit bostonharborislands.org.

Our deep water moorings and dockage can accommodate vessels up to 250 feet in length. Vessels over 60 feet looking for transient moorings should hail on the radio when entering the harbor. Come to Vineyard Haven Marina: we're here to make your Vineyard visit an experience that will exceed your expectations! All moorings are on the outside of the break-wall. marinas.about: About PLEASE MAKE RESERVATIONS DURING OFFICE HOURS - MONDAY THROUGH FRIDAY 9am to 5pm. PLEASE DO NOT ASSUME THAT YOUR RESERVATION HAS BEEN ACCEPTED UNTIL YOU RECEIVE A CONFIRMATION FROM US. The historic Seven Seas Wharf has been in continuous operation for over 350 years in Gloucester Harbor, one of the oldest commercial fishing ports in America. Some of the first settlers in Gloucester used the Seven Seas Wharf for the processing of fish to be shipped to England, and South America in exchange for salt, clothing and other essentials of daily life. Gloucester men had exchanged salt fish for molasses in the West Indies. They then made rum on this wharf from the molasses. Much of the rum was then shipped to England for finished manufactured goods that the early colonists needed. Some of the supporting beams of this wharf were once main masts of old fishing schooners and clipper ships joined together by treenails (oaken pegs) ten inches long. marinas.name: Cape Cod Marine Properties
marinas.about: About Cape Cod Marine Services is a 35 slip marina located near the mouth of the Cape Cod Canal's western inlet. Boaters can enjoy easy of access to both Cape Cod Bay and Buzzards Bay. We are only a 10 minute walk from the Buzzards Bay train station which provides service to both the Cape and Boston. We provide boaters with the perfect starting point to explore everything the Cape and Islands have to offer. Our visitors love to spend the day walking the Cape Cod Canal and enjoy the world-class stripe bass fishing from the shore. If you are in the mood for a round of golf, we are only a 3 minute drive from the The Bay Pointe Club. After a nice round of golf you can enjoy a drink at Captain Al's Tiki Bar.

marinas.about: This quintessential New England destination, nestled conveniently between Boston and Cape Cod, is best known for its Native history, the Pilgrim story, and one of the country’s most iconic landmarks – Plymouth Rock. But history is just the beginning of what visitors come to experience here in Plymouth County. With everything from water sports to whale watching - golfing to ghost tours -Thomas Land to trolley tours - cranberry harvests to culinary tours… you’ll find yourself planning your return visit before you even leave! marinas.name: West Dennis Yacht Club
marinas.about: About Traditions play a big role in the development of any social organization. While many WDYC traditions have come and gone, many still remain. Harkening to the days when the club closed for the winter months, the Commissioning is held on Memorial Day weekend to mark the beginning of the summer season and typically features dinner and dancing. The Commodore’s Ball, typically Labor Day weekend, marks the passing of the flags to the new officers of the club for the coming year. This event is also normally marked by a dining and social event. Finally, the De-Commissioning, typically held on Columbus Day weekend marks the traditional end of the season with another social gathering. Each of the more “formal” activities, particularly the Commodore’s Ball, features the “striking of the colors” accompanied with the firing of the WDYC cannon. marinas.name: Jubilee Yacht Club
marinas.about: Jubilee Yacht Club is located on the historic north shore in Beverly, Massachusetts, home of the schooner Hannah which was the first armed American naval vessel of the American Revolution and is claimed to be the founding vessel of the United States Navy. JYC has carried on yachting traditions for over a century. A private membership based organization incorporated in 1896, the club continues to thrive with over 500 active members. Jubilee has an active cruising fleet, a busy regatta schedule, an active social calendar, and frequent fishing tournaments. The club is also a strong supporter of junior sailing. The Marina features sheltered, deepwater dockage, and is approximately a mile and a half upriver from one of the premier sport fishing and sailing areas in the Northeast. The Marina comprises 192 slips on three docks. In addition to the Club House, amenities include ample on site parking, a pool, and men’s and women’s restrooms with hot showers. The Club offers memberships for sale, transient dockage, as well as the opportunity to join on a seasonal basis with summer slips and winter land storage.

We are an authorized dealer for Sportsman, Roth Bilt and Eastern boats as well as Yamaha, Evinrude and Suzuki outboards. In addition, Millway Marina has an ever-changing selection of quality pre-owned boats and motors. Our service department is headed by a Master Certified Yamaha /Evinrude technician with over 10 years of experience. Whether you're looking to purchase a boat or keep yours running smoothly all season long, you can depend on our skill and dedication to meet your needs.

marinas.name: Safe Harbor Plymouth
marinas.about: Rich colonial heritage and legendary boating are close at hand. Centrally located on the Massachusetts coast, Safe Harbor Plymouth enables a convenient departure point for exceptional cruising and fishing grounds. Take an afternoon stroll to town and explore the many historic monuments and pubs, or simply dock your boat and take in a beautiful New England sunset. Note: All dock assignments are subject to change on a day-to-day basis. Boats under 30' might not be placed on a finger dock.

marinas.name: Bridge Marina
marinas.about: Bridge Marina is one of the oldest maritime facilities on the Merrimack River. Since the 1800s this facility has been used for shipbuilding and repairs, as a Standard Oil terminal and most recently as Bridge Marina. Located just across the river from scenic Newburyport Mass, Bridge Marina has the capacity to dock 110'+ boats ranging from small craft to 60' vessels. The marina’s close proximity to the mouth of the river makes Bridge Marina an ideal marine docking location. In 2016 the facility was upgraded to include a new pier and boat docks made of the highest quality Batu (an Indonesian hardwood known for exceptional strength and durability). This new docking system now also features power pedestals at every slip with dual 50Amp 125/250V twist-lock receptacles, dual 30-amp receptacles, and dual water faucets to accommodate all of your marine water and power requirements.

marinas.name: Cohasset Harbor Marina
marinas.about: If you are looking for that quiet private spot located within a pristine New England Harbor, a visit to Cohasset Harbor Marina fits the bill. Protected and serene, nestled in a secluded section of Cohasset Harbor, CHM offers boaters the true flavor of both yesterday’s and today’s New England coastal towns. Unfortunately we do not accept any transient dockage as we are 100% full with a waiting list. If you would like to be added to the waitlist or have any questions feel free to call us at 781 337 1964!

In addition to our great display of new boats, we have a number of well cared for, Pre-owned Boats for Sale. We operate an In-Out launch service for qualified boats with full water-side facilities. Bayside Marine is proud of its corporate awards. We have consistently received high honors from our customers for our sales and service. Every day we strive to provide the best service possible and make it easy for your family to have fun. Established in Duxbury in 1949, Bayside Marine has the expertise and reputation for satisfying the most discriminating boat buyer.

marinas.name: Barden's Boat Yard
marinas.about: Barden’s Boat Yard does sell gas and diesel, but we do not have a traditional ‘gas dock’. Our staff is on duty daily during the week and weekend mornings. Because the dock to access the fuel is also a working dock, we have to coordinate when a boat needs to come in for gas or fuel. Simply contact the office prior to arriving by boat to arrange for fuel. Valet Service is available for fueling, too. Barden’s Boat Yard offers a public launch service for Marion’s Inner Harbor. Launch service is included with our mooring rentals, but for those who don’t need a mooring, our launch service is available for you either by purchasing a seasonal pass for unlimited rides to and from your boat for the entire summer, or on pay per trip.

marinas.name: Arey's Pond Boat Yard
marinas.about: Arey’s Pond has been a landing for recreational and merchant mariners since the 1600’s. Since 1954, the waterfront service location has been home to our mooring field, docks, rigging shop, engine shop, sailing school, and reception area. Just off of Little Pleasant Bay and the Namequoit River, Arey’s Pond offers services for sailboats and powerboats alike, as well as quick access to Cape Cod’s largest estuary and some of the best sailing and scenic views in the area.

TGM Anchor Point Marina is a boutique facility with 72 slips.

marinas.about: Mystic Seaport Museum provides an ideal destination, especially for those traveling by boat. Located on the charming and historic Mystic River, we are a short distance from Long Island Sound and offer well-protected docks that are north of both the Mystic River Highway Bridge and the Amtrak Mystic Railroad Bridge. We recently installed 820' floating docks and updated shore power offerings. Boaters and their guests receive complimentary museum admission while docked at Mystic Seaport. We invite you to stroll through our 19th-century seafaring village, climb aboard historic vessels, and explore exhibit halls. After visitors are gone for the day, our guests have the unique opportunity to enjoy the beauty of our grounds in the evening, an experience reported by many to be the most magical part of their stay. marinas.name: Louis Marine
marinas.about: Nestled on the Menunketesuck River in scenic Westbrook, Louis Marine is a small family-owned and operated marina and dealership. Whether you’re looking to fish in a quiet spot, water ski, or cruise around with friends, Louis Marine offers easy access to all that Long Island Sound has to offer. The marina offers a small boat ramp for seasonal customers, with slips on both the East and West side of the launch. The East caters to both jet skis and shallow-water vessels; while the West side can accommodate vessels up 26' with approximately up to a 3' draft. Water and 30amp service are available on the docks. Louis Marine is located central to two fuel docks as well as several local eateries including Bill's Seafood, Lenny and Joes and Haywire, a burger bar favorited by locals and visitors alike. marinas.name: Old Lyme Dock Company
marinas.about: For years the Old Lyme Dock Company has provided fuel, slips and other essential boating needs to boaters on Long Island Sound and the Connecticut River. We're located just a short distance from some of the Connecticut Shoreline's most beloved and historical attractions. Whether you're just fueling up for a day on the water, or in need of a over night or seasonal slip, we can accommodate your needs. Our staff is skilled and courteous, and our fuel prices are the best around. For skippers of larger vessels, the Old Lyme Dock offers the most frontage of any of the other local fuel docks! If you need to come ashore, you'll love our clean and spacious restrooms and showers.

marinas.name: Mystic Shipyard West
marinas.about: Enjoy the tranquility of our riverfront swimming pool! Convenient to Fishers Island Sound and south of all bridges, Mystic Shipyard is located in one of New England's premier cruising destinations. The beautiful Mystic River is a serene, safe setting that has always appealed to mariners. Enjoy the resort type atmosphere of the Mystic shipyard throughout the season in convenient and protected slips.

marinas.name: Mystic Point Marina
marinas.about: Home to the tall ships of Mystic Seaport and New England's only beluga whales at Mystic Aquarium, the town of Mystic exudes New England charm. Shop one-of-a-kind shops downtown (with its landmark Bascule Bridge) or at the quaint Olde Mistick Village. Enjoy visiting the Planetarium and walking through historic Mystic Seaport, or grabbing an ice cream and watching the Bascule Bridge lift to let some of the visiting yachts (such as musician Eric Clampton's on his annual visit) pass under the bridge. Saybrook Point Marina offers world class amenities and provides high quality service to yachts of all sizes. marinas.name: Town Of Fairfield

marinas.about: About Yankee Boat Yard & Marina, Inc. is a full service boat yard and marina located along the Connecticut River in Portland, CT. Our location has a long history, originally as a boat building operation in the early 1920’s and 30’s, and as a boat yard from that time up until the present. We have approximately 50 slips along the river and we accommodate up to 30 boats on ball moorings for our summer boaters. In the winter, Yankee Boat Yard has capacity to store up to 400 boats on land including indoor cold storage as well as indoor heated storage. We have new, spacious state-of-the-art facilities for our mechanical, paint & fiberglass repair, woodworking, welding & metal fabrication shops. There is a parts department and a fully stocked ship’s store on site to service the needs of our marine customers. Anything you might not see in stock, please ask. marinas.name: Essex Boat Works
marinas.about: About Essex Boat Works is a premier full service yacht maintenance facility providing outstanding craftsmanship by top skilled professionals in all the marine trades. We have the plant and the people to care for your boat completely, from the top of the mast to the bottom of the keel and everything in between. Our people are efficient and dedicated to great customer service. Our yard has modern, top of the line equipment, to support our professional staff in caring for your boat. Our owner, manager and his team are personally involved in all aspects of our services. Our rates are competitive and our value is unbeatable. Bring your boat to Essex Boat Works and see why discriminating yachtsman from all over the world have trusted us with their boats for over fifty years.

marinas.name: Old Harbor Marina
marinas.about: Our convenient location and quick access to Long Island Sound makes Old Harbor Marina the boaters's choice. We are a full service marina with capabilities to serve all of your motoring or sailing needs. Our friendly staff can provide mechanical, electrical, refrigeration, air conditioning, rigging, wood and fiberglass repairs, or new installations.

There is also limited year-round rack. Dry winter storage is also available. The Dockmaster’s office can be reached at 203-618-9698 or by cell at 203-898-5795.

marinas.name: Don's Dock
marinas.about: About Don’s Dock Marina in Stonington, CT is a family-owned and operated business serving the boating community from Fisher’s Island to Watch Hill for over 30 years. We offer premier dockage, mooring, a whole range of boating services and improved access to Stonington Harbor. Our docks are nestled along the protective shores of Lambert’s Cove but offer quick access to Long Island Sound’s best fishing. Located just outside historic Stonington Borough and across from the Captain Nathaniel Palmer House, it’s easy to soak up New England’s rich maritime past. marinas.address: 48 Calf Pasture Beach Road, East Norwalk, CT 06855
marinas.about: Norwalk Cove Marina is Connecticut’s complete yachting center, conveniently located within an hour drive of New York City. Norwalk Cove is a well-protected deep-water basin situated at the mouth of the Norwalk Harbor. We offer our customers top notch facilities and a knowledgeable and friendly staff. We have over 400 slips ranging from 20’ to 190’. Our summer season runs from April 15 through October 15. Off-season transient stays also available. We are a full service marina with professionally maintained docks, ramps and floats. Security cameras are located throughout the property to provide peace of mind for our customers. Customers can count on a safe and reliable dockside power supply with free wireless internet. Our fuel dock is equipped with high speed fuel pumps for ValvTec Marine fuel and pumpout facilities. The fully stocked marine store carries everything from cleaning supplies and bottom paint to zincs and coolers as well as sandwiches and convenience items and a gift boutiq

marinas.name: Mystic River Marina
marinas.about: Mystic River Marina is located on beautiful Masons Island, in a protected area below the bridges. In this tranquil setting, boaters enjoy views of Long Island Sound and picturesque sunsets. Known as New England’s Finest Yacht Basin, this full service marina has been family owned and operated since 1957. At Mystic River Marina, we provide the highest quality amenities and cater to some of the most discriminating boaters on the east coast. Our professional and courteous staff is here to serve your boating needs. Dedication to dependable service has been our trademark for over 65 years! With 145 slips, Mystic River Marina offers Shell fuels, Kitchen Little restaurant, our top-notch service department, well-stocked ship’s store, swimming pool, courtesy kayaks and paddleboards, clubhouse, playground, patio with bbq grills, immaculate heads/showers, laundry facilities, free wi-fi, free pump-out and a year-round discount.

marinas.name: New Haven Yacht Club
marinas.about: The New Haven Yacht Club is a co-operative of sailors and sailing-oriented folks. We are an informal group dedicated to helping each other spend as much time on the water as possible. We enjoy daysailing, racing, cruising, and social events. We love sailing! Boats are located on moorings or dry-sailed and we do not have any slips or rent boats. We have one 400 lb guest mooring, available for sailboats, with a maximum capacity of 11,000 lbs and a maximum LOA of 35 feet. Stays are limited to three days. Our guest ball is offered for free this season on a first come, first serve basis, however, guests must use their own dinghy as transport to and from the dock. We have an outdoor shower, pavilion, and restroom facilities which are open when our launch attendants are on duty. Please book in advance by contacting us through Dockwa so that we have your insurance and vessel information. Find out more about becoming a member at www.nhyachtclub.club

There is beautiful kayaking and paddle boarding through the Norwalk Islands, Village Creek and Farm Creek. The Club mooring field accommodates sail and power boats of varying drafts. Club launch service runs from 8AM-11 PM seven days a week from memorial day to labor day, after labor day Launch service runs from 8AM-9 PM Sunday to Thursday and 8AM - 10PM Friday and Saturday. marinas.name: Pine Island Marina
marinas.about: Pine Island Marina offers 110 slips that can accommodate power boats up to 42 feet in length. Each slip features upgraded shore power and fresh water hook-ups. Seasonal moorings are very popular at Pine Island Marina. We have 50 moorings available and can accommodate vessels up to 35 feet. We offer launch service and dinghy storage for our mooring customers. Our dinghy docks have been completely revamped, and launch service is available 7 days a week – full time on weekends and on call during the week. While relaxing out on the mooring, enjoy the view and peaceful setting of our sheltered harbor. For those looking for a “boat on trailer” solution we are happy to offer contracts for May through October. Being located adjacent to the Bay Berry State Boat Launch makes your boating experience just that much more convenient all season long.

marinas.name: Indian River Marina
marinas.about: Welcome to the Indian River Marina in Clinton, Connecticut! The marina is situated about one-quarter mile up the Indian River from the Clinton Harbor where three rivers – the Hammonasset, Indian, and Hammock – converge on their way to Long Island Sound. The lovely tidal wetland setting is ideal for shallow-draft vessels and allows convenient access for sailing and fishing on Long Island Sound and paddling in the rivers running into Clinton Harbor. Rent a kayak, canoe, or stand-up paddleboard and launch directly into the Indian River, or you can arrange a drop-off to other nearby waters. We also offer very reasonable rates on slips and winter storage. The marina is located within easy walking distance of historic downtown Clinton where antique shops, restaurants, art galleries, and pleasant quiet streets lined with cottages and restored captains’ homes provide a wonderful location for strolls and casual dining.

Our marina provides a quiet, relaxing atmosphere with a close proximity to all the restaurants, shops, and other tourist attractions. Our location is between the bridges providing protection and calm waters for a pleasant stay. The railroad bridge is usually open for boat traffic. When the bridge is closed for train traffic, you may hail the Mystic River Railroad Bridge on VHF Channel 13 to inquire about the next opening.

We provide boaters with a comfortable home port and all the amenities of a first-class marina.

marinas.name: Clinton Town Dock
marinas.about: About The Harbor Management Commission develops policy and makes recommendations to the Board of Selectman for the operation of the Town Marina. The Dock Master is appointed by the Board of Selectmen and manages the day to day operations of the Town Marina. The marina offers a unique and picturesque setting with a view of Clinton Harbor and has convenient access to Long Island Sound. The Clinton Town Marina is known as the "jewel of Clinton" located in a protected harbor. Many restaurants are within walking distance of the marina. There is also a snack bar located within the facility.

marinas.name: Safe Harbor Yacht Haven
marinas.about: Awards About A gateway to Long Island Sound, Safe Harbor Yacht Haven is a popular home port for boaters exploring Block Island, Martha’s Vineyard, and Nantucket. Casual cruisers and ocean voyagers alike can enjoy a relaxing weekend barbeque with friends or easy access to New York City.

marinas.name: Safe Harbor Dauntless Shipyard
marinas.about: About Situated on the west bank of the Connecticut River, stunning New England summer sunsets await. As a sister facility to the nearby Shipyard, Safe Harbor Dauntless affords Members a full-service marina experience near the charming shopping and dining of historic Essex.

marinas.name: Guilford Yacht Club
marinas.about: The Guilford Yacht Club, nestled among vast, virgin salt marshes on the bank of the West River in Guilford Connecticut, is Long Island Sound’s premiere yachting facility. To appreciate it fully you must experience it all – spacious floating docks, luxurious swimming pool, showers, Har-Tru tennis courts and a superb club house complete with an exquisite banquet facility for catered events. The Guilford Yacht Club is a full service facility providing yachting, swimming, tennis and various social activities in a true resort environment. As far as the eye can see, one is surrounded by undisturbed natural beauty, including spectacular views of Long Island Sound and Faulkner’s Island. The Guilford Yacht Club is easily accessible from Long Island Sound and is a short distance from the town of Guilford, CT. Founded in 1954, the Guilford Yacht Club is a member-owned entity.

marinas.name: Safe Harbor Essex Island
marinas.about: Safe Harbor Essex Island is a true boating retreat for rendezvous gatherings, yacht club festivities, and more. Quietly placed on its own 13-acre island, Safe Harbor Essex Island is a waterfront destination for locals and cruisers alike. Unwind by the oversized pool, enjoy a game of volleyball with family, or explore the vibrant village atmosphere in nearby Essex. ALL special requests (slip preference, early arrival or departure, boats you are traveling with, special electric needs, handicap needs, boat accessibility, etc.) NEED to be told to marina staff BEFORE your arrival. marinas.name: Pine Orchard Yacht Club
marinas.about: About The Pine Orchard Yacht & Country Club is a private club catering to the social and athletic interests of our members and their families. The Club was founded in 1901 when plans were drawn for the golf course. Around 1917, yachting was added and in the early 1920's, the Clubhouse was moved to its current location. Throughout the years, facilities were added and improved upon. Today these facilities include: a 9-Hole Golf Course, 8 Har-Tru and 2 Hard Tennis Courts, Olympic Swimming Pool, Kiddie Pool, Men's, Women's, Boys' and Girls' Locker Rooms, and a 100-Slip Marina as well as our fine Clubhouse. While moorings and slips are available to boaters, the Pine Orchard Club is a private Club. The facilities of the Club are for the sole use of its members and their guests. Transient slip and mooring holders do not have access to the golf course or tennis facilities. Amenities like the swimming pool and restaurants are available for reciprocal yacht club members only.

In addition to our 140 slips and excellent marina service, Port Clinton Marina also provides a full range of boat commissioning, winterization, hauling and storage services.

Cove Landing Marine, a full service boatyard located in Hamburg Cove has been run by John R. Leonard since 1978. Cove Landing performs a wide range of services from full restorations and overhauls on fine yachts and wooden boats to yearly maintenance.

marinas.name: Sag Harbor Launch, Moorings & Services
marinas.about: Sag Harbor is a location second to none. Only a 30 mile ride from Block Island and 20 miles from New London, boaters can easily access destinations in Long Island and Block Island sounds. There is no shortage of things to do while visiting Sag Harbor. Check out our beautiful beaches, grab a bite downtown, or stop in at The Sag Harbor Whaling and Historical Museum. Come experience why Sag Harbor is one of the most desirable boating destinations in the northeast. We offer transient mooring reservations inside the break wall for boats up to 50ft and in the Outer mooring field for boats 50 to 150ft in length. Additionally there are moorings available on a first come first serve basis. Please contact the Sag Harbor Launch on channel 73 when entering the harbor.

marinas.name: Cardinal Cove Marina
marinas.about: Cardinal Cove Marina offers 5 deep water moorings, with no bridges in Stonington Harbor. For boaters looking to stretch their legs, downtown Stonington provides a variety of activities. 5 great restaurants that are an easy walk from the dingy dock. There are also shops and art galleries. If you need Provisions it's a short walk. Cardinal Cove Marina also offers seasonal dockage for 70 boats under 24ft in length. They are all floating docks, and the Marina is well protected. Cardinal Cove Marina allows quick access to Long Island and Block Island Sound's best fishing locations.

marinas.name: Rondout Yacht Basin
marinas.about: Our 16-acre sheltered location offers an unlimited variety of summertime activities. Swim or relax poolside, enjoy great food at our dockside eatery or barbecue in our park-like picnic area. Reconnoiter the Rondout Creek in your inflatable (just like the British fleet searching for the revolutionaries’ Lady Washington galley in 1777), or visit the Hudson River Maritime Museum. It’s all here in one great location. Dock at one of our full-service slips, and enjoy the swimming pool, dockside café, picnic grounds, and horseshoes… Our facility has everything in one protected location. We offer competitive rates for seasonal or transient dockage and other services. Come enjoy quality boating in a great setting and historic area. Whether you’re with us for one night or for the season, stay, relax and play, or branch out from home to explore other attractions. marinas.about: Awards About Founded in 1889, Indian Harbor Yacht Club has a distinguished history of yacht racing and boating. Located in Captain Harbor on western Long Island Sound in Greenwich CT, the club provides members and guests an ideal setting for year-round enjoyment. Whether racer or cruiser, sailor or powerboater, blue water enthusiast or coastal cruiser, Indian Harbor is the perfect family-friendly place to relax, have fun, compete and build friendships. Guest and transient moorings are available. There are no membership requirements for making a mooring reservation. Moorings include use of the Club Launch.
