marinas.name: Crocker's Boatyard, Inc.
marinas.about: Whether cruising from Maine to Florida or looking for a new overnight spot, Crocker's Boatyard is a great family destination. Attractions include a lively and culturally diverse city with over 30 restaurants, within walking distance to historic Fort Trumbull and minutes' drive to beaches, shopping, and the US Nautilus museum— Crocker's amenities include a pool, laundry, floating docks and, a hauling capacity of 75 tons, a complete ship store, a full-service facility and the most protected marina in Southeastern Connecticut. Crocker's location is situated just minutes from New London's transportation hub, which includes trains and ferries. Celebrating over 140 years of family ownership, now in our 5th generation. Summer Dockage Rates*: Under 20' $2675/season 21' to 44' $145/foot 45' to 54' $8900/season Rates do not include facilities fees or taxes. The pricing listed is discounted for cash/check payments.

marinas.name: Branford Yacht Club
marinas.about: Founded in 1909, the Branford Yacht Club is located near the mouth of the Branford River. The marina consists of five docks and twenty-three river stakes that can accommodate yachts as large as sixty feet. The club offers membership to those residents of New Haven County at least twenty-one years of age. The beautiful buildings and grounds are meticulously maintained by both the members and the staff of the Branford Yacht Club. In addition to expertly maintaining the facilities, our staff also tends to the gas dock. Whether you are a member or a guest of the Branford Yacht Club, we hope you enjoy your time with us! Welcome to Branford Yacht Club!

The Shoals presses pause on the urban pace, offering an elemental retreat providing space and calm in the wild magnificence that Is rural, coastal New York. marinas.name: Seaborn Marina

A family owned and operated organization dedicated to providing the ultimate boating experience. We are centrally situated on the South Shore of Long Island, less than 1 hour from NYC, 4 miles to Fire Island and 6.5 miles to Fire Island Inlet. A short stroll takes you to Main Street Bay Shore where some of the top rated restaurants and gastro pubs are located. Our staff provides a large range of services dedicated to the avid fisherman or the family of pleasure boaters. Transient dockers are always a welcome addition and for those who prefer to sleep off their boats the Ocean Bay House is conveniently located on the marina property (Opening August 2017). marinas.name: Great Peconic Bay Marina
marinas.about: At Great Peconic Bay Marina (GPBM) we offer a friendly, helpful and fun resort like atmosphere where you can spend quality time with friends and family while enjoying the pleasures of being a boater on the beautiful North Fork of Long Island. GPBM is located in the quaint town of South Jamesport. You can find us by water where the Great Peconic Bay and the Flanders Bay meet, known to many as Hawk's Creek. By land we are a short 7 miles East of the end of the Long Island Expressway. We have been family owned and operated since 1978. We have always taken pride in our service, marina facilities and our effort to make your boating a trouble-free delight. We are a complete full service marina with an informal atmosphere. Leave our entrance channel and you will be boating in the Great Peconic Bay!

marinas.name: Gilbert Brook Marina
marinas.address: 715 Lake Shore Road, West Chazy, NY 12992
marinas.about: Gilbert Brook Marina is located on Lake Champlain, 12 miles south of the U.S.- Canadian border, 8 miles north of Plattsburgh, New York and just across the street from our associated Campground. Gilbert Brook's location at the center of Monty Bay offers the relaxing and low-stress environment associated with open waters with gentle breezes, and breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding New York and Vermont shorelines and mountains; we're also conveniently located halfway between the open sailing waters of Burlington, VT to the south, and the border crossing on the Richelieu River of Quebec, Canada. Our season extends from May 1st to October 1st. As one of Lake Champlain's newest marinas, Gilbert Brook offers modern, convenient facilities at affordable rates. An airbnb is available for rent across the street from Marina.

marinas.name: Long Point State Park on Lake Chautauqua
marinas.about: The park's boat launch is the most modern on Lake Chautauqua, which, at 1,308 feet above sea level, is one of the highest navigable bodies of water in North America. The lake has a plentiful supply of bass, perch, pike and other types of fish, but fishermen come to Chautauqua to fish for muskellunge. Muskellunge, or muskie, are native to the lake, noted for their size--often more than 30 inches long (in fact they must be at least 40" to keep) -- and their "fight." In winter, visitors can cross-country ski, snowmobile or fish. Boat Launch, marina and pump out station. Marina Slips are available thru the Park. Fuel, boat rentals and a small restaurant are available thru a concessionaire on site. Showers are available at the beach bathhouse. There are picnic tables and grills and available for use. There is a guarded beach normally available Mid-June to Labor Day weekend - check operating hours/days. Pets are welcome in the park, but must be on a leash. Proof of rabies vaccination via Vet

marinas.name: Mitchell Park Marina
marinas.about: Mitchell Park Marina is located in the center of the waterfront Village of Greenport. The marina contains 60 floating slips and a 640' standing pier. The floating slips can accommodate vessels up to 80'. The standing pier can accommodate up to 250' and offers single phase 208V and 240V electric as well as three phase 480V electric. All overnight stays are made in advance and through Dockwa.com (No reservations are taken for day stays). Reservations can be requested for 7 nights or less. Any requests greater than 7 nights need special approval by marina staff. Mitchell Park also contains a historic Carousel which is open year round, as well as an Ice Rink during the winter months. CHECK OUT: Check out is PRIOR to 11 AM. If you wish to check out later than 11am, the request must be placed at the time of your original reservation request. We reserve individual slips months in advance, and chances are your slip will have an arrival immediately after your departure time.

marinas.name: Ponquogue Marina
marinas.about: Ponquogue Marine Basin is a full service, year round marina, that is a family owned and operated. The marina is conveniently located on Shinnecock Bay, just one nautical mile west of Shinnecock inlet. Ocean beaches and restaurants are within walking distance. The village of Hampton Bays, which is 2 miles away, offers shopping and more dining options. Today the Marina has 75 slips of dockage for boats of up to 45 feet in length. These are floating docks with fingers offering water and electric. You may choose transient or seasonal dockage. You may also choose to store your boat for the winter. The marina stores 120 boats during the winter on land. This is made possible with a 55 ton travel lift for boats of up to 65 feet in length and a 19' beam.

marinas.name: Fishers Island Yacht Club
marinas.about: Fishers Island Yacht Club offers a friendly, fully-staffed seasonal marina with plenty of transient dockage. The club is pleased to extend to its guests the privilege of using some member-only spaces such as our covered veranda that opens onto a lovely waterfront lawn where picnic tables and a large charcoal grill are available. Likewise, marina guests may use our showers and heads. Uses of other FIYC spaces can be arranged on advance request. The Marina is centrally located and makes a great starting point to explore a bit of this quiet picturesque island. Everything from the ice cream shop, bike rentals, and the museum plus a grocery store, deli, and restaurant are within easy walking distance. Fuel is located right next door. FIYC also offers vessels 26' and under temporary dockage for a few hours. Sit back and relax in the cockpit to watch the sunset and gathering dusk across our truly beautiful and tranquil harbor. marinas.name: Ernst's Lake Breeze Marina
marinas.about: About Ernst’s Lake Breeze Marina is located on the banks of the beautiful Oak Orchard River, just a quarter-mile from Lake Ontario. The six acre waterfront property hosts a marina which fulfills all boating enthusiast needs and wants. Family owned by Gatlen and Danielle Ernst, the marina operates from April 1st through October 31st, seven days a week including all holidays. Stop in and have a one on one experience with some of the best in the business. We are a full service marina dedicated to top notch customer service. We offer 80 docks for rent, indoor and outdoor storage, repair and maintenance work, gas, diesel and propane sales, parts and accessories, cottage rentals and an on site restaurant serving breakfast and lunch. We are also home to many of the local fishing charter boats.

marinas.name: Manhasset Bay Marina
marinas.about: Manhasset Bay Marina is located in a sheltered harbor just off Long Island Sound and just 35 minutes from Manhattan. Our large, very well maintained 300 slip facility with modern floating docks and pedestal electric hookups can accommodate vessels to 110'. Other marina amenities include fuel, mechanical repair services, ice, restrooms and showers, laundry facilities, free wi-fi and 24 hour security. Seasonal and Transient Dockage is available. Our full service yard offers haul outs up to 75 tons and complete engine and hull repairs by certified and qualified staff. Winter inside, outside, and wet storage is available. Manhasset Bay Marina has been family owned and operated for the past 50 years. The entire LaMotta family is dedicated to making your stay enjoyable!

marinas.about: Located on the north side of Shelter Island, Dering Harbor Marina offers fuel, slips, and moorings all within walking distance of shops, restaurants, and accommodations. Dering Harbor Marina provides fuel for small to large boats. Fuel options include Marina Mobil Super 93 Octane, diesel fuel, and propane. Ice and pump out service is also available dock side. Seasonal and transient slips up to 160 feet are available. Slips feature 15 to 100 amp electrical hook-up, barbecue grills, and fresh water. Visitors also have access to restroom and shower facilities with hot-water. Moorings are available for power boats up to 38ft and sailboats up to 42ft. There is a dingey dock available for mooring reservations. No launch service is provided. Parking is available on site. Nearby attractions such as beaches, golf courses, tennis courts, and restaurants. Bicycles are also available for rent at Piccozzi's Bike Shop across the street from the marina.

The newly renovated luxury seaside resort & marina spans 16 acres on Lake Montauk with world-class dining at Ocean Club Montauk restaurant & bar, 107 coastal-modern guest rooms & historic villas, and elevated amenities. Our Clubhouse building, which is located in the center of the docks, has served as a village landmark since 1914 and houses a lounge and shower/restroom facilities. The Sag Harbor Yacht Club is located within a five minute walk to the center of Sag Harbor’s Main Street and a short car or bike ride to the surrounding Hamptons. Conveniently located in the center of Long Island’s South Fork, Sag Harbor is also close to many historic sites, vineyards, scenic vistas and some of the world's best beaches. The beach and high dunes are pristine with a sleepy rustic national park feel to escape and enjoy a day at the beach. For boaters and day trippers, Fire Island Water Taxi stops at Sailors Haven with Service to all Western Fire Island Destinations including to Cherry Grove, The Pines, Point of Woods, Ocean Bay Park, Seaview, Ocean Beach, Atlantique, Kismet and the Light House Cherry Grove is about a mile walk on the boardwalk. Ocean Bay Park is walkable or cyclable along the beach. Visitor Services. General Store, Cafe & Outdoor Bar. marinas.name: Westerly Marina
marinas.about: Westerly Marina was founded on the Ossining Waterfront in 1959 by Arthur DeMarchis after an extensive search to relocate the Tobin Craft boatbuilding business from New Jersey. The 24 foot wooden motorboats were at the new yard in a converted seaplane hangar until 1962, when wooden boat construction gave way to fiberglass at larger facilities. At the time Westerly began expanding its marine construction, docking, storage and repair capabilities. DeMarchis focused his work on boats to mechanical project, become a dealer for Mercury out boards and specializing in the re-powering of boats. Over the years DeMarchis gradually acquired the adjoining lots on either side of the boat shop, including a large building directly to the south of the yard, previously owned and used by the Rand McNally map company. marinas.name: Freeport Yacht Club
marinas.about: One fine evening, back in the winter of 1930, five Freeport volunteer fireman of Truck Co.No.1 (of the old Extension Hook and Ladder Company) sat down with a bottle of gin and some Limburger Cheese, for the usual rag chewing contest. Since most of them had small boats, The conversation naturally drifted to boating and the fine times they had while cruising and fishing in the creeks and bays around Freeport and the adjoining towns. Someone suggested, “Why don’t we get together next summer and go on a cruise to Shelter Island?” Now there was an ambitious undertaking! There was no Jones Beach Tower to sight at and there were no State Channel or any channel markers in those days. Here and there, a dry sapling was driven into the bottom of the bay by clam diggers, or a stick, but one had to belong to the inner circle to know what they indicated. marinas.name: Pilot Knob Marina
marinas.about: About Originally founded in the 1920s, the Pilot Knob Marina is one of the oldest marinas on lake George, nestled in the heart of the Adirondacks in Pilot Knob, NY. We have been upstate New York’s premier CHAPARRAL boat and ARCTIC CAT power-sports dealer for over 33 years. Our Sales outlet is located on route 149 South of Lake George village, and is open 5 days a week Tuesday-Saturday from 10-5, while our marina can be accessed by land or water in Pilot Knob. marinas.name: Dredge Harbor Boat Center
marinas.about: In 1939, Bill Parsons Sr. and his brother Herb traded their interest in two cars for a down payment on a sandpit located along the riverfront. The riverfront was being dredged and the brothers had the foresight to see the potential of the future boating needs of the area. Dredge Harbor Marina was on its way to becoming the largest full-service marina in the Delaware Valley. In the early 1940s, brothers Bill and Herb had developed the "sandpit" location with a few in water slips and began selling such famous boat lines as Broadwater Yachts and Greenwich boats, which they sold in varying quantities after the second world war. In 1946, the brothers became boat dealers for a company called Chris Craft, which remained their principal boat line until the New York Boat Show of 1978 where Jack Purcell convinced them to invest in an up-and-coming west coast boat company called Bayliner. marinas.name: Cassidy's Breton Woods Marina
marinas.about: Cassidy's Marina is owned and operated by Hugh and Mark Cassidy. The Cassidy brothers have been involved with the marina since 1981 and are both actively involved with every aspect of the marina. The original marina was built in the 1930s but it wasn’t until the early 1980's that the marina expanded to its present capacity of 185 slips with a max LOA of 35 feet. Known as a family friendly boat yard, Cassidy’s encourages boaters to bring your whole family down to the water and relax. Cassidy’s is nestled in a small riverfront neighborhood on the Metedeconk River, just 2 short turns off of Mantoloking Road in Brick. Many local customers keep their boats docked or stored Cassidy's Marina. People from Toms River and Point Pleasant choose Cassidy’s because of the beauty and convenience the Metedeconk River offers and its family and fishermen friendly atmosphere. marinas.about: Welcome to Canyon Club Resort Marina, Cape May’s premier full-service boating facility. Located on the northwest corner of Cape May Harbor at the eastern entrance to the Cape May Canal, Canyon Club is the regional center for boating and its related activities. Whether it’s an overnight stay, a yacht club rendezvous, big game fishing trip or service and repair, Canyon Club is second to none in catering to the seasonal slip holder and traveling yachtsman.

marinas.name: Cape May Marina
marinas.about: Cape May Marina is conveniently located just off the Delaware Canal offering slips up to 65 ft., fuel, clean new bathrooms, 70 ton travel lift, and jet ski ports. Well sheltered, there is limited commercial traffic in the Spicer's Creek channel. Less than one mile from the local grocery store and 200 yards from the local package good store the marina location also offers a half dozen restaurants within walking distance. Completely rebuilt by current ownership in 2015 Cape May Marina offers something not found anywhere else in Cape May New Jersey. Live the waterfront life style with us at the Cape May Marina.

marinas.name: Liberty Landing Marina

marinas.about: Liberty Landing Marina is a 520 slip marina located on the Hudson River across from the lower tip of Manhattan. We offer transient dockage, 24-hour fueling facility, full-service maintenance, marine store, and much more! The Marina is strategically located in Liberty State Park along the Morris Canal and is the only marina in the area that provides a “calm basin” for boat dockage in the Hudson River. Our guests enjoy the luxury of a full-service marina with a well respected service team. Our large dock staff will cater to your every need, including a well-stocked marine store. We have two on-site restaurants, a ferry to NYC, Statue of Liberty tours, and we are just a few minutes away from the Liberty Science Center. The first-class, well-renowned restaurants have panoramic views of the Manhattan skyline, fine dining, indoor and outdoor seating, a private lounge, and more. This soon expanded and Lockwood sold not only rowboats, but runabouts, cruisers, motors and trailers. In 1954, Lockwood purchased a piece of property on the Cheesequake Creek for a new marina with 13 slips. The need for further expansion led to the purchase of an additional 24 acres. This has since been transformed into the marina that exists today. The Lockwood family still owns and operates all aspects of the business. The personalized service provided by each member of our family is what makes this yard so special. We have all been in the marine business for all of our lives. marinas.about: About The Canalfront Park Marina is open between April 1 and November 30 and has 19 boat slips to accommodate seasonal and transient boaters. The large slips can accommodate a boat up to 55' in length and 16' beam. The small slips can hold a boat up to 25' in length and 12' beam. Tantallon Marina is just a short one-mile drive to shopping and restaurants. Less than a 30-minute drive to the Nations Capital. Tantallon Marina combines the magic of a remote getaway with the convenience of a nearby highway. Come stay with us and you will understand why Tantallon Marina is the Upper Potomac’s best kept secret!

marinas.name: Waterman's Crab House
marinas.about: About Waterman's Crab House Restaurant and Dock Bar is ideally situated at the foot of Sharp St. in historic Rock Hall on Maryland's upper Eastern Shore. With a history and reputation reaching back over 40 years, our picturesque waterfront location has evolved from a local seafood market providing fresh catches of blue crabs, rockfish, oysters and other Chesapeake fare, into the award-winning family restaurant that it is today. We invite you to experience the very best in Chesapeake Bay waterfront dining. In addition to "Best of the Bay" award-winning steamed crabs, Waterman's Crab House Restaurant and Dock Bar is widely acclaimed for its full service menu, including jumbo lump crab cakes, fresh catches of local fish, BBQ ribs and a delicious variety of daily specials and landlubber favorites.

marinas.name: Clinton Street Boatel
marinas.about: Oasis Marinas at Clinton Street Boatel is a quick ride to Baltimore’s Inner Harbor, with a beautiful view of the Patapsco River and Fort McHenry. The marina offers a full service fuel dock on-site with pump-out and great storage options for boaters. From the high & dry racks, outdoor storage area and state-of-the-art repair and service facility, guests can feel at ease as their boats will be taken care of. In-Season Hours of Operation: 9am-4pm Daily Fuel Dock: Sunday - Sunday 9am - 4pm

marinas.name: Chesapeake Bay Maritime Museum
marinas.address: 213 N Talbot St, St Michaels, MD 21663
marinas.about: Established in 1965, the Chesapeake Bay Maritime Museum in St. Michaels, Maryland, is a world-class maritime museum dedicated to preserving and exploring the history, environment and people of the entire Chesapeake Bay. Located along St. Michaels Harbor and the Miles River in the heart of St. Michaels’ historic district, CBMM’s Members-Only Marina is a short walk from the area’s best restaurants, specialty shops, and other attractions. Docking at our marina offers a unique opportunity to immerse yourself in the rich maritime heritage of the Chesapeake Bay. The marina is open daily and offers 55 slips, accommodating vessels up to 200′ in length and a maximum draft of 10'. Amenities include electric, pump-out service, climate-controlled showers, Wi-Fi, picnic tables, and bicycles. St. Michaels also offers a harbor shuttle service, a harborside fuel dock, and convenient driver services.

marinas.name: Chalk Point Marine
marinas.address: 4914 W Chalk Point Rd, West River, MD 20778
marinas.about: Located in the scenic rural countryside of southern Anne Arundel County on West River of the Chesapeake Bay, our marina offers convenient access to Annapolis, St. Michaels, and Oxford on the Eastern Shore. With an on-site caretaker living in a classic river cottage on the property, slip holders receive immediate attention. ​Customers enjoy a well-maintained property graced with decades-old oak trees, informal gardens, and a lovely waterside picnic area. Just 45 minutes east of Washington and 20 minutes from Annapolis, you can enjoy our breathtaking sunsets from the comfort of your cockpit in no time. The only rush hour traffic you'll have here are the geese and osprey landing on the river!

marinas.name: National Harbor Marina
marinas.about: National Harbor Marina is nestled along a bustling 350-acre mixed use development area with seven hotels, offices, residential, tree-lined streets, more than 150 shops, 30 restaurants, iconic attractions such as the Capital Wheel and National Harbor Carousel, and much more. With easy access to Washington, D.C. and Alexandria, VA, National Harbor Marina makes for a premier destination for boaters on the Potomac River. In Season: Sun-Wed: 9am-7pm Thurs-Sat: 9am-10pm Off Season: Mon- Sun 9-5

marinas.name: Rod 'N' Reel Marina
marinas.about: Marina guests enjoy full privileges at the resort, which include showers, restroom and complimentary laundry facilities (you provide the soap), use of the fitness center and sauna, and outdoor pool & indoor pool. The Rod 'N' Reel Dock includes 260 slips, along with a fleet of charter boats, one head boat (boat that charges per head), a fuel dock, marina store that has so much to offer and a fish-cleaning tables for our special guests. With no long, winding creeks or rivers to navigate, our marina is one of the Chesapeake Bays easiest-to-reach marinas and a favorite of expert boaters and fishermen. Our marina can only accommodate vessels with a draft up to 3.5 feet.

marinas.about: If you are looking for a new home port for 2026, a weekend getaway, or a fresh place to store for the winter, Gratitude offers seasonal, monthly, and transient slips, as well as dry storage. This season, we have a discounted winter storage rate for new storage customers at $17/foot. In addition to these savings, NEW slip-holders receive FREE winter storage for 2025/2026 winter season. Gratitude Marina is a sister marina to Osprey Point. This relationship entitles all slip-holders to receive a 5% discount on rooms at the Osprey Point Inn, including the Annex, located right on the Bay at Gratitude. Gratitude slip-holders also have access to all Osprey Point amenities (restaurant, pool, bikes, etc.). Besides service and slips, Gratitude also has one of the easiest access fuel docks the Chesapeake offers, with competitive fuel prices, and the most generous fuel rewards program on the Bay. The Osprey Point/Gratitude Slip Holders offers 10¢ off per gallon to all its members.

marinas.name: North Point Marina
marinas.about: North Point Marina is family owned and operated in Rock Hall. Visit our Ship's Store, cool off in our pool, just feet from the bay with expansive views, or enjoy our pavilion areas for group or private dining. Our close proximity to the open waters of the bay makes this a sail boater's dream come true. And power boaters LOVE our large covered slips, keeping things cool and dry throughout the summer months. Whether this is your first time here or you are a long time, annual customer, you will feel like family... because you are! Enjoy the relaxed atmosphere, the stunning views, and great service. We also have a 5 unit motel that overlooks the bay. The Town of Rock Hall has a shuttle service that stops here at NPM taking you all around the shops and eateries that are on Main Street, and we have several restaurants that are just a short stroll away. Come and experience what Shore Life is all about. See you soon!

marinas.about: Located on Maryland's Eastern Shore of the Chesapeake Bay between St. Michaels and Tilghman Island. Come join us in our island like setting and watch our spectacular sunsets. marinas.name: Hyatt River Marsh Marina
marinas.about: Hyatt River Marsh Marina at Hyatt Regency Chesapeake Bay, is one of the premier marinas and resorts in the Chesapeake Bay. The marina and resort is designed for every type of boater, and offers many amenities for guests, most notably Maryland's leading Eastern Shore golf course. Other activities on-site include miniature golf, tennis, water activities, indoor and outdoor swimming pools, live entertainment, fitness center, kayaking, and the famous Sago Spa and Salon. Boaters will also enjoy a variety of dining options that will appeal to everyone in your group. The Hyatt Regency Chesapeake Bay Marina also caters to big events and is a perfect option for your next big party or wedding.

marinas.name: Ocean City Fisherman's Marina
marinas.about: About O.C. Fisherman’s Marina, located in West Ocean City, Maryland, is just minutes from the Ocean City Inlet, provides deep water dockage and safe haven with no tidal surges or currents. Conveniently located at the head of the commercial fishing harbor, it offers quick, unobstructed access to the inlet and open ocean. We offer Dockage up to 75’, transient dockage up to 105’, electric (30-50 amp), water, shower, ice, in-slip fueling (ethanol free gas and diesel), and laundry facilities. We are a Co-Operating Marina with Boat US who is located onsite. We are also a short walk from 8 of West Ocean City’s finest restaurants.

marinas.name: Long Cove Marina
marinas.about: Long Cove Marina is a family owned business in Rock Hall, MD. The Deckelman's are the owners and offer a full service marina that includes a repair shop, propeller shop, 3 travel lifts, dingy storage, covered slips, fuel and more. We offer many services including boat bottom painting, washing & waxing, engine repair, propeller repair, slip rentals, winter storage, haul outs and more. Our fuel dock is open year round for gas & diesel and seasonal for pump outs.

marinas.name: North Bay Marina
marinas.about: North Bay Marina is located in the heart of Joppatowne, Maryland on Gunpowder River. We have wet slips and high/dry racks available for our guests. Our fueling dock offers 89 & 93 octane fuel, a pump out station, and quick access to our marine store for all your boating needs. Our store carries an array of products ranging from boat supplies to live bait! A fully equipped service center, Argentino Marine, for all your maintenance and repair needs. Pool memberships are an included perk for slip holders, and season passes are available for the public. Multiple food options are here onsite for the entire community to enjoy, not just our boaters! Enjoy fresh crabs and seafood for carryout from Carnival Crabs, or come down by the water to enjoy food and drinks at our brand new Tiki Bar for our opening season!

marinas.name: Baltimore Boating Center
marinas.about: Welcome to Our Beautiful Marina on Middle River! Looking for a place to dock or launch your boat? Come visit us! Our marina offers protected waters and easy access to the Bay, making it the perfect spot for both new and seasoned boaters. We’re all about making your experience as smooth and enjoyable as possible. We’ve recently expanded our hours and focused even more on great customer service. With new electric hookups for overnight slips and a larger staging area, we’ve got everything you need for a hassle-free boating experience. Plus, we’ve added more work racks for cleaning and repairs so you can keep your boat in tip-top shape. Locally owned and operated, we’re proud of our marina's upgrades, including new piers and newly remodeled bathrooms and showers (finished in 2024). We were even honored with the Marina of the Year award from Dockage Magazine! We’re also a certified Maryland Clean Marina, so you can feel good about being here. Need to host an event? marinas.about: Welcome to South Annapolis Yacht Centre (SAYC); the exclusive in-town destination marina with 74 annual and transient slips accommodating vessels up to 135 feet. Following a fresh vision after an extensive redevelopment, SAYC is part of a rich Annapolis maritime heritage and will be a beautiful marina village, a state of the art boatyard, and office spaces available to local maritime businesses. Our new marina features floating piers, Ipe decking, state-of-the-art power pedestals, a new three-phase power grid, and many other amenities. SAYC is conveniently located along Spa Creek in the historic Eastport area of Annapolis, Maryland. Considered the most protective haven for yachts in the area, our location upriver of the Spa Creek drawbridge is protected, quiet, and less subject to the wakes, currents & wind associated with being in the harbor. marinas.name: Anchor Bay East Marina
marinas.about: At dawn most days you can usually count on two things on Bear Creek in Dundalk, Maryland: the calm of the water as the sun rises and the barrage of activity at Anchor Bay East Marina. The family-owned marina was founded 28 years ago this July, by Art and Tina Cox. With the help of their children, parents, brothers and sister, they have established and grown a successful full service marina. The Cox's have focused on making Anchor Bay East Marina more than a place to service and store your boat. Over the years they have added many amenities including a dock bar and restaurant. With year-round and transient slips available we hope you visit us very soon!!

marinas.name: Cambridge Yacht Club
marinas.about: Cambridge Yacht Club is located in the scenic historic district of Cambridge, MD and is the Eastern Shore's premier destination for boating, fine dining, and memorable special events. Cambridge Yacht Club offers award-winning cuisine served with panoramic views of the Choptank River. Enjoy cocktails and lite fare at the dockside gazebo, or warm up by the fire in our comfortable lounge. The Choptank River has some of the best sailing on the Eastern Shore. Our marina has affordable deep water slips for boats of all sizes, transient slips and locker room facilities. We have weekend cruises and raft-ups, several annual regattas, Thursday night dinghy races, and a vibrant Junior Sail Program.

marinas.name: Hinckley Bachelor Point
marinas.address: 26106 A Bachelor Harbor Drive, Oxford, MD 21654
marinas.about: Set just inside the mouth of the Tred Avon River, Hinckley Bachelor Point offers a breathtaking vantage over the Chesapeake Bay. Surrounded by 14 peaceful acres—including a dedicated wildlife sanctuary—this premier marina is a true haven for yachtsmen. The protected eight-acre basin features 80 deep-water slips for vessels up to 120 feet, complemented by a 75-ton travel lift, expansive dry storage, and three indoor storage buildings. With over 6,000 square feet of dedicated service space, the facility is fully equipped for expert mechanical work, repowers, and refinishing. Here, the natural beauty of Maryland’s Eastern Shore meets Hinckley’s hallmark service and craftsmanship—ushering in a new era of yachting on the Chesapeake.

marinas.name: Lankford Bay Marina

LBM has been voted one of Chesapeake Bay’s 10 Best Marinas by Chesapeake Bay Magazine readers multiple times. The marina includes a ship's store, repair services including a 40 ton travel lift, swimming pool, free pump-out service, and an air conditioned bathhouse. Both diesel and gasoline are sold at the fuel dock. Other amenities include an on-site washer & dryer, free Wi-Fi, cube & blocked ice, picnic areas with grilles and tables, kids play area and 100 seat pavilion. During the winter, LBM offers wet or dry winter storage for boats and different shrink-wrap services.

McDaniel Yacht Basin was established in 1929 by Dick McDaniel and was purchased by Tom Trainer in 1954. Galahad Marine Properties purchased the marina in 2016 as part of a portfolio of marina properties.

marinas.name: Goose Bay Marina and Campground
marinas.about: About Goose Bay Marina is located off the Potomac River in Welcome, Maryland. Enjoy the simple things in life as you take in the beautiful, nature scenery that surrounds the marina. At Goose Bay, there is always a friendly staff member around to make sure your stay is enjoyable. The marina has five piers including one floating pier, as well as three boat ramps, and can accommodate boats of all sizes in one of their 250 slips with 1x30 and 2x30 shore power options. With the on-site full-service marine maintenance, you will never have to worry about boating mishaps. Don’t want to sleep on your boat? The marina has 90 shady, waterfront campsites. Goose Bay Marina and Campground hosts many family oriented events throughout the year, making it the perfect place for a family getaway. You won’t want to miss this Southern Maryland gem this boating season!

marinas.name: Gregg Neck Boat Yard
marinas.about: About Gregg Neck Boat Yard is a full-service facility on the upper Chesapeake Bay, Maryland, on the beautiful Sassafras River. Located north of the drawbridge, on a secluded and peaceful part of the river. We are a small family-owned operation serving this area since 1979. The Sassafras River boasts many desirable qualities for boaters. It is a sheltered, fresh tidewater river lined with great anchorage, beaches, and creeks to explore.. Unlike most of the Chesapeake Bay, the Sassafras River is sea nettle free and it's fresh water is less corrosive on engines and hulls.

marinas.name: Inner Harbor Marina
marinas.about: Located in the heart of downtown Baltimore, Inner Harbor Marina offers one of the most iconic boating destinations on the Chesapeake Bay. Dock just steps from the vibrant waterfront promenade, with panoramic city views and walkable access to restaurants, entertainment, museums, and professional sports venues. Our marina accommodates vessels from cruising sailboats to large yachts, with floating concrete docks, in-slip pump-out service, and a full-service fuel dock. Guests enjoy modern amenities including showers, laundry facilities, high-speed Wi-Fi, gated dock access, and a comfortable boater’s lounge. From your slip you can walk to Baltimore’s top attractions, including the waterfront promenade, Federal Hill neighborhood, and nearby stadiums. Whether you're visiting for a weekend getaway, a city event, or a seasonal stay, Inner Harbor Marina provides a unique blend of marina hospitality and downtown waterfront energy.

Paradise Marina offers a serene, laid back oasis on the protected waters of Herring Bay and in Rockhold Creek. It serves as the launching point to all of the Chesapeake Bay’s popular destinations allowing boaters easy access to some of the best fishing and sailing on the Bay. Amenities include water and electricity on the piers, pathway and dock lighting, bathroom and showering facilities, picnic area and plenty of parking. We are Maryland's closest marina to Philadelphia, PA and Wilmington, DE and many of our customers come from the York, Lancaster, and southeastern Pennsylvania communities. Kayaking and Canoeing on the Chesapeake BayWe offer a quiet, family oriented setting with open space, ample parking, lawn and trees, modern facilities, picnic tables with gas grills and much more. marinas.name: Tilghman Island Inn
marinas.about: About The writer from Gourmet Magazine may have summed it up best when he described the Tilghman Island Inn as “part convivial house party and part comfortable hostelry.” Something about the magnificent panorama of water–where the strand of Knapp’s Narrows meets the Chesapeake Bay–lends itself to a special brand of soothing, laid back ambiance, which is then garnished with just the right touch of elegance and first rate service. Tilghman Island itself, which is only gradually and grudgingly giving way to the modern world, reflects a way of life still shaped by the timeless, unhurried rhythms of the water, nature and the seasons. Yes, bring your watch, but make sure to set it to Tilghman Island Time. For boats transiting Knapp’s Narrows bound for points to the east or west, or boats heading up or down the Bay, our location at the Western (Bayside) entrance to Knapp’s Narrows makes us a convenient and accessible stopping point no matter where you’re headed. The White Marlin Marina offers the most conveniently located fuel dock in Ocean City, with the capability of accommodating up to 125ft vessel. Deep draft vessels will have no concerns with water averaging 12 foot at low tide. No need to wait at the fuel dock, more than ¾ of the marina has convenient in-slip fueling. marinas.name: Cape Charles Town Docks
marinas.about: The Cape Charles Town Marina ably hosts a unique mix of commercial, industrial, and recreational vessels in its protective basin boasting 95 slips, 4 T- Heads ranging from 60 to 120 feet and 1200 feet of dock space. Whether for work or play, patrons enjoy access to the greatest fishing areas on the Chesapeake Bay. Visitors can watch watermen haul in and off-load their daily catches of blue crabs, horse shoe crabs, conchs, fish, clams, shark and scallops. The Harbor’s state-of-the-art public boat ramps are enjoyed by both individual pleasure and sport fishing crafts as well as the charter boats that run expeditions daily for cobia, striped bass, flounder, drum, spade, trout and croaker. Transient vessels appreciate the Harbor for its deep-water slips and docks and short walk to the re-emerging Historic Town.

marinas.name: Regent Point Marina & Boatyard
marinas.about: Located in the lower Chesapeake Bay region, Regent Point Marina possesses exceptional access to the Rappahannock River, Chesapeake Bay, Washington D.C., Richmond, and northeast North Carolina. The marina houses 132 slips and accommodates vessels, including motor, trawler, and sail, between 16’-60’ with a max draft of 6 ½’. Regent Point offers a climate controlled bathhouse, lockers, dinghy racks, pump out, boat ramp, ice, laundry machines, bicycles, kayaks and canoes, picnic area with grills, playground with a basketball court, free WiFi, and three apartments. We have a full service boatyard with a 35 ton Marine Travelift, ABYC & Yanmar-certified technicians, a 15 ton crane, and is do-it-yourself friendly. Their impeccably maintained grounds and extensive amenities guarantees a good experience both on and off the water.

marinas.name: Norview Marina
marinas.about: Norview Marina is located in Deltaville, Virginia, just an hour and a half east of Richmond. Primarily a boating community, Deltaville boasts a perfect balance between the relaxing tranquility of coastal living and the convenience of a modern, well-equipped luxury marina complemented by a touch of southern hospitality. Our easily-accessed location on Broad Creek, at the mouth of the Rappahannock River is ideal for laying over whether you are heading north or south, in the Atlantic or in the Chesapeake. We can accommodate yachts to 80′ with amenities that will make your stay a joy. We also have Zimmerman Marine on-site, one of the mid-Atlantic’s finest repair and service facilities. Whether you are stopping by for a few nights or want to spend the season in one of our state-of-the-art floating slips, covered slips or in our “boatel”, you will enjoy friendly service and high quality accommodations at Norview. Hours of Operation: 7:30am-5pm Daily.

marinas.name: Safe Harbor Stingray Point
marinas.about: Awards About Slip holders enjoy many amenities including three bathhouses and a pool in a park-like setting. In addition, the marina holds a variety of social events throughout the season to create a fun atmosphere and build community. Safe Harbor Stingray Point is the eastern-most marina on the western shore of the Chesapeake Bay, at the mouth of the Rappahanock River on Broad Creek. The Marina is located 1.5 miles East of Deltaville, Virginia on State Route 33. Surrounded by a heavily wooded area, it is the last developed area on the left before turning to Safe Harbor Stingray Point. It provides access to the wonders of the Bay within a few minutes: its secluded creeks and scenic rivers, its open waters for distance sailing, its abundant wildlife (eagles, ospreys, porpoise, gulls, wading birds and waterfowl) and its copious fishing and seafood grounds.

marinas.name: Willoughby Marina
marinas.about: With a long history of serving the Hampton Roads area, it is time for Willoughby Harbor Marina to sail into a new chapter. Now, Willoughby Marina is woman owned and operated marina that is located off of I-64 Hampton Roads Bridge Tunnel (HRBT), quietly tucked away in Willoughby Spit. The new owners, being mariners themselves, are proud locals of the Norfolk area that want to keep historical locations like this from washing away. With big plans for the future, Willoughby Marina is here to serve both locals and transients alike.

marinas.name: Hope Springs Marina
marinas.about: Hope Springs Marina is a full-service marina located on a protected section of beautiful Aquia Creek, offering a 300 rack indoor fully enclosed boathouse, 180 deep water slips, 4 paved launch ramps and 700 feet of sandy beach, all just minutes from the Potomac River. Only four miles from Interstate 95 (Exit 140), Hope Springs boasts over six acres of parking, a picnic area with a fire-pit and a spectacular clubhouse for our guests. Boaters will appreciate the variety of amenities available, including an on-site convenience store, a fully tiled and air conditioned bathhouse with showers, and a laundry room as well as a nicely equipped fitness center. 30 amp metered electrical hookups, and a modern pump-out and dump station are found on the docks.

marinas.name: Morningstar Marinas | Little Creek
marinas.about: Morningstar Marinas/Little Creek located just inside the Little Creek Channel off the Chesapeake Bay is excited to provide a professional, knowledgeable, and friendly staff to assist with all your coastal cruising needs. We recently installed a new Bellingham Dock System yielding wider slips with full-length finger piers, clear main walkways with tri-frame dock box placement and state of art power pedestals . Additional onsite amenities include a bath house, laundry room, showers, new Wi-Fi, pump out, ValvTect fuel and Stony’s Dockside Waterfront Bar & Grill. The marina is also within walking distance to COVA Brewing Company and close to Norfolk and Virginia Beach restaurants, shopping, and entertainment allowing our marina guests the opportunity to experience everything which makes this area and our marina so inviting.

marinas.name: Waterside Marina
marinas.about: The Waterside Marina is conveniently located in Downtown Norfolk. New Floating Docks and Power installed in 2020. Amenities include: showers, floating docks, 20 foot depth, ice, complimentary grocery shuttle service, winter storage and free wireless internet. Walking distance to Norfolk's shopping, restaurants, arts, entertainment and attractions.

marinas.about: Dandy Haven is a manmade harbor located on Back River in Hampton, Virginia. We have complete facilities for boat storage and repair, and a highly trained staff of Master and Certified technicians to meet your needs. As a member of the marine industry, we support our trade association (Virginia Marine Trades Association) in it's efforts to serve the Virginia boating community. We understand that clean waterways enrich the boating experience for everyone, and therefore provide support to the community for volunteer activities. Dandy Haven participates in the Chesapeake Bay Foundation's oyster farming program, annual Watershed Shoreline Cleanup, and underwater grass growing and transplantation projects. Dandy Haven's storage facilities include 68 wet slips with both fixed and floating docks, and 34 sheltered dry storage slots. Fixed and floating docks will accommodate boats up to 45 ft in length. marinas.name: Windward Point Marina
marinas.about: Windward Point Marina is a small, quiet facility in Pamlico County, North Carolina. The marina is just minutes away from popular sailing grounds, including the Pamlico Sound, the Neuse River, Oriental, and of course, the ICW. Entrance to the marina is made from Broad Creek near the junction of the Neuse River and Pamlico Sound. For boaters tired of busy marinas and crowded access roads, Windward Point is the perfect antidote to your marina blues. We offer a remote, wooded location and surprisingly quick access not only to sailing waters but also to the nearby towns of Oriental and Bayboro where sailors can find practically any needed service or product. What can you expect at Windward Point? As the name implies, the marina is nearly always breezy - a sailor's dream! Intimate, quiet, and far removed from concerns of the workday life, Windward Point is perfect for solo sailors, couples, and family looking for a little piece and quiet along the beautiful inner coast of North Carolina.

marinas.about: Nestled in the heart of historic Southport, our freshly dredged marina offers unparalleled access to the Intracoastal Waterway and the scenic Cape Fear River. Whether you're docking for a night or planning an extended stay, you'll love our prime location—just steps from charming downtown shops, waterfront dining, and beloved local attractions. We’re excited to welcome you to our docks and ensure your time on the water is both relaxing and memorable. Safe travels—we look forward to seeing you soon!

marinas.name: Morehead City Transient Docks
marinas.about: The Morehead City Docks located at 807 Shepard St., Morehead City, NC is a mid-Atlantic stopping point for those cruising north/south, fishing the Bogue / Core Sound and Outer Banks’ waters, or beginning the ocean voyage to the Caribbean and beyond. This sheltered, deep-water basin has 8-10 foot minimum depths at dockside, and easy access to the Intra-coastal Waterway and Beaufort Inlet. MCD offers 10 slips (26 ft. to 50. ft. long with widths to 20 ft.). Floating docks assure easy passenger access to docked vessels regardless of tide conditions. Amenities include: electric hookups and water. Conveniently located on the Morehead City waterfront and within walking distance to banks, shops, Post Office, churches, Webb Library and many fine restaurants. Please note: We have a minimum dockage fee of $50.00 plus an additional $2.00 per foot for boats over 26 feet. Dockage fee includes water and electricity. All reservations are processed through Dockwa; Checks and Cash are NOT accepted.

marinas.name: Dowry Creek Marina
marinas.about: Open 8am to Sunset daily, call ahead for early or after hours arrival and we will have someone at the pier to guide you in or fuel your boat. Discover peaceful Dowry Creek Marina (just 3 miles north of Belhaven, NC) at ICW mile 132, your first stop after the 20 mile Alligator River - Pungo River Canal. Bear 350 degrees at Pungo River green day marker 15 and cruise through our well-marked channel. We offer protected, deepwater slips on beautiful Upper Dowry Creek. Enjoy fabulous views from the porch of our ships's store, cool off in our swimming pool; fuel up or re-fill your LP tanks. Relax and meet your fellow cruisers at a nightly get-together in the clubhouse. Dowry Creek Marina offers you much more than the typical marina you encounter on the Intracoastal. Dowry Creek Marina strives to make you feel at home with their amenities, including a sparkling clean saltwater pool, a fully-furnished clubhouse, and grill/picnic area. The marina is a popular destination for yacht clubs.

marinas.name: Beaufort Town Docks
marinas.about: Beaufort Town Docks is one of the most popular stops for cruisers and sailors traveling the Intracoastal Waterway. This all-transient marina features 42 floating docks accommodating vessels up to 55 feet, along with over 850 linear feet of side-tie dockage for vessels up to 250 feet. Every slip offers fuel service directly at the dock for maximum convenience. Ideally positioned for coastal cruising, Beaufort serves as a strategic gateway to the islands, with the Gulf Stream typically just 30 miles offshore—making it an excellent stop for both short stays and offshore passage planning. No marina is closer to the inlet or the exceptional dining, shopping, and attractions of historic downtown Beaufort. For Day Dock usage please use coupon code "DAYDOCK" at check out. This will result in your 1st 3 hours free, after 3 hours the reservation will be charged a nightly rate of $1.95/ft Day Dock is limited to vessels up to 35 feet and the 6 slips inside the first west dock.

marinas.name: Safe Harbor Peninsula Yacht Club

With exceptional facilities and activities, the Club carries on the legacy of quality and luxury of the community. We offer a new dimension to life on the lake, including a wide variety of organized boating and year-round social events. The clubhouse features a full-service dining room and lounge with an expansive veranda providing spectacular water vistas. The emphasis is on casual good times with exceptional dining experiences. We have 405 slips ranging from 25' to 45'. We provide a safe harbor for all! We have a full service Marina team that oversees your every need. With 5 transient slips at our gas dock, we provide our members access to bring friends by boat for lunch or dinner. There are many amenities, with first rate facilities and programs to accommodate your love of boating.

marinas.name: Germantown Bayside Marina NC
marinas.about: This waterfront site is our personal home. However, we keep the boat ramp open most of the year. A $5 launch fee helps us keep the ramp and a parking area clean and repaired. The ramp is closed during duck season, mid-November through January, except that we maintain year-around access for local commercial needs such as oystermen and waterfowling guides. We have enough dockage to accommodate our local crabbers and oystermen as a priority. However, if you need short- or long-term dockage, we might be able to help. People tell us they prefer this launch to the nearby Rose Bay NC Wildlife Ramp because it is closer to the Pamlico, saves them time and boat gas, and is sheltered from the Rose Bay or Pungo River waves when the winds are up. Hyde County is a special place for recreation, wildlife, and artists, and we enjoy helping others enjoy this special place. Sail the Sound, cruise the intercoastal waterway, drop anchor at nearby towns or enjoy water skiing on glassy water. marinas.about: Discover the perfect destination for family-friendly waterfront fun at our premier marina. From boat rentals and docking services to exciting water activities, there's something for everyone to enjoy. Immerse yourself in the beauty of the surrounding scenery while creating unforgettable memories with your loved ones. Explore our website to plan your next adventure at our family-friendly marina today. All of our customer slip docks were built in 2008 or newer. These docks are heavy duty, commercial strength, galvanized steel frame construction with concrete or composite decking on all exposed docks and wood decking on our covered dock. Your boat is safe with us.

A popular destination for over 60 years, boating enthusiasts and waterway travelers have enjoyed Wacca Wache Marina’s idyllic harbor as a recreational stopover or launching spot. Wacca Wache Marina is conveniently located at ICW Marker #383 on the beautiful Waccamaw River in Murrells Inlet, South Carolina. Amidst lofty oak, cypress and palmetto trees, our full-service marina offers a relaxing spot for boaters to relax, fish, and dine in a beautiful waterfront setting. The marina offers affordable rates on wet slips and rack storage, boat trailer storage, fuel services, clean restrooms and showers, and a collection of amenities to enhance your experience. marinas.about: Centrally located at mile marker 357 on the Intracoastal Waterway, the Grande Dunes Marina is one of the finest marinas on the ICW.​Grande Dunes Marina is the perfect place to begin your adventure on the Intracoastal Waterway. With 126 wet slips and 1,200 linear feet of lay-along floating docks, the marina offers a protected harbor for vessels up to 120 feet. Our marina is open to the public and features state-of-the-art floating docks, diesel and gasoline, a marina store, showers, restrooms, laundry, and other nearby conveniences. Visit our on site restaurant, 357 Raw Coastal Bar, the only restaurant in Myrtle Beach on the ICW. 357 Raw serves lunch and dinner. Enjoy a sunset beverage during happy hour at our full service bar.

marinas.name: Harbour Town Yacht Basin
marinas.address: 160 Lighthouse Rd, Hilton Head Island, SC 29928-7207
marinas.about: For more than 50 years, the red and white striped Harbour Town Lighthouse has welcomed visitors to one of the most unique and beautiful places on earth. Located in the heart of The Sea Pines Resort, and ideally situated on Hilton Head Island's captivating Calibogue Sound, the Harbour Town Yacht Basin is recognized as a premier yachting destination on the Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway. The full-service marina welcomes boaters year-round and offers slip rentals and sales, fuel, professional yacht sales and brokerage dealer, as well as a friendly, experienced staff. Developer Charles Fraser, considered the pioneer of Hilton Head Island, led the team that constructed the Harbour Town Yacht Basin in 1969. Inspired by a harbour in Portofino, Italy, Fraser's vision for the basin was to attract mariners to Hilton Head Island, while preserving the island's natural landscape. marinas.name: Safe Harbor Beaufort

Spend a day sailing along the Beaufort River or enjoy a leisurely picnic at the tranquil Waterfront Park. Conveniences like slip-side parking and a ship’s store complement modern amenities and the many restaurants, galleries, and shops of downtown Beaufort.

As you enter this gated community, you immediately become part of a world removed from ordinary distractions. First impressions record an immediate feeling of natural beauty and serenity. Surrounded by almost 640 acres of park-like gardens, woods, and lakes, you’ll find many, many kinds of wildlife. It sits on a bluff, looking directly across wide and navigable Winyah Bay to miles of shoreline that will never be developed, thousands of acres of pine forest and salt marsh dedicated to marine conservation by Belle Baruch. Please note, amenities (pools, tennis courts, Yacht Club, Rice Canal Club and Beach House) are for owners and their guests only. marinas.name: Windmill Harbour Marina
marinas.address: 161 Harbour Passage, Hilton Head Island, SC 29926
marinas.about: Welcome to Windmill Harbour Marina, situated on the northwest coast of Hilton Head Island, South Carolina. We are located on the Intracoastal Waterway, just ½ mile south of the Pinckney Island Bridge at mile marker 558, 500 yards south of channel marker 27, and ½ mile north of channel marker 29 in the Calibogue Sound. The marina's 15.5 acre harbour boasts 258 boat slips, from 25 ft. to 70 ft. Slips are available for rent or purchase. Transient dockage is available. Our remarkable harbour offers a safe, tide free haven protected by a lock system directly off the Intracoastal Waterway. The Windmill Harbour Marina lock is 75' long by 19' wide. Hours of operation are 0800 to 1900 by harbour master or 24 hours by yachtsmen with a keycard. We monitor channel 14 VHF and our phone number is 843-681-9235. One of only three private locked harbours' on the east coast, Windmill Harbour Marina offers an unparalleled combination of convenience and security...the safest place to keep your yacht.

The scenic town of Port Royal presents seaside cultural treasures and outdoor excursions for every recreational enthusiast.

marinas.name: Lady's Island Marina
marinas.about: Lady's Island Marina in Beaufort, South Carolina, is known for its natural beauty, convenient location, and friendly management. We are located on the protected waters of Factory Creek, less than 1/2 mile from the ICW (Marker 536). Slips are available for transient and long-term rentals. We have a boaters' lounge, courtesy car and loaner bikes. Overlooking the marina is longtime local favorite, Dockside Restaurant. Next door (almost) is Beaufort hangout The Fillin' Station, with a covered deck set above Factory Creek. On-site the the marina boathouse, you'll find Journey Marine Canvas, One Salon, massage therapy and the Lady's Island Marina Store. Everything else you might need is within a mile on Sea Island Parkway, including groceries, hardware, liquor store, pharmacy, additional restaurants, banks, medical & dental and veterinary care. Historic downtown Beaufort is 1 mile away.

marinas.name: The Ashley Marina
marinas.about: The Harborage at Ashley Marina is a large, professionally managed marina capable of accommodating vessels up to 125 feet in length. The marina consists of approximately 230 wet slips and is located in the medical district of historic downtown Charleston. We provide complimentary OnSpot Wifi throughout the marina. All of the docks are Ipe and offer electrical service of both 30 & 50 amp service to all slips in the marina. In addition, the main face-dock offers 100 amp single and three-phase 208v electric. There are plenty of restaurants and grocery within walking distance. Height restrictions due to bridge: 55 Feet. Daily rates only for vessels on the face-dock April-June and Oct/Nov.

marinas.name: Palmetto Bay Marina
marinas.about: Palmetto Bay Marina, featuring all new docks and amenities, offers boaters the safety, convenience, and comfort of a full-service marina on the warm Carolina coast. We're only 1/2 mile from the Intracoastal Waterway, located in the heart of Hilton Head Island, South Carolina. We can easily accommodate vessels up to 150+ feet. We're excited to have completed our multi-phase restoration project at Palmetto Bay Marina. All of the facilities have been fully renovated including docks, wifi, integrated power supply, showers/restrooms, fueling stations, patio areas, and more. We’re seeing lots of boats from the loop this season making their way to the island for great weather and a slow-paced attitude. Our location, tucked inland, provides 22 feet at low tide making an ideal stopover for larger vessels, sailboats, and catamarans. No height restrictions and wide hulls are welcome.

marinas.name: Safe Harbor Bristol
marinas.about: Sitting on a quiet stretch of the Ashley River neighboring Charleston’s historic district, Safe Harbor Bristol bestows boaters with easy access to open water and the rich culture of one of the top cities in the country. Take your boat out for a day of wakeboarding, then come home to a meal in the heart of Charleston. Cap your evening with one of the regular fireworks displays at the Riverdogs baseball game.

Dine on site at the Morgan River Grill! Exclusively for our overnight transient guests, enjoy full access to the resort-style community, including golf and tennis, indoor and outdoor pools, fitness center, croquet, bocce, and more. Please inquire within for access to these great features and activities! Fuel, restaurants, ship store, island amenities available; please inquire with our Harbormaster. We have designed the marina to provide our members with a private parking lot for convenient and secure access, easy long approaches at our docks to simplify the docking process, and the entire facility is all brand new! marinas.name: Fripp Island Marina
marinas.about: The Fripp Island Marina is a full-service facility on Old House Creek. The marina is located just miles from the Intracoastal Waterway. Just 30 minutes down the road, Beaufort, SC was named the 108th best town for sportsmen by Outdoor Life Magazine in its June/July 2009 edition, joining the publication’s second annual list of 200 towns across the country. In 2008, Field & Stream Magazine listed Beaufort No. 2 on its list of best fishing towns in America with a population under 100,000 residents. Our amenities are designed to make life onboard easy and enjoyable, including free laundry facilities, complimentary beer on tap, and fresh water available at every dock. Whether you’re stopping in for a few days or planning to stay long term, Brunswick Landing Marina offers a welcoming atmosphere that keeps boaters coming back year after year.

That’s why we’ll take care of your boat like it’s our very own. We have 4,000 feet of concrete docks with 600 feet of deep water face docks. We even have a Mega Yacht Dock for vessels up to 220 feet. marinas.about: "Where Coastal Charm Meets Open Waters — Golden Isles Marina isn’t just a stop, it’s a destination. Nestled in beautiful St. Simons Island, GA, our marina offers more than just a slip — it's a full-service coastal retreat. From the independently owned Coastal Kitchen restaurant (NOW OPEN) to a marina store, sparkling swimming pool, a ASA-certified sailing school, on-site mechanic and on-site detailer, everything you need is steps away. Relax on our covered observation deck with a gas grill, refresh at the hair salon, shower and laundry facilities, and soak in the full Golden Isles experience. Whether you're cruising through or setting sail, you'll find yourself perfectly positioned to enjoy the island’s world-class beaches, history, golf, tennis, shopping, and dining. Discover your dockside paradise — and make it unforgettable." marinas.address: 1 Old Tybee Rd., Hwy 80, Tybee Island, GA 31328
marinas.about: About Transient dockage: $2.50/ft. Monthly rate: $14/ft. Established in 2003 Tybee Island Marina is just minutes from the Intracoastal Waterway and the mouth of the Savannah River.The perfect safe haven for transient or local mariners and just 15 minutes from historic Savannah,We serve ethanol free gas as well as Valvtec marine diesel and we have a dedicated 168 foot fuel dock.We are a secure, deep water Marina with over 2000 linear feet of dock space with clean restrooms, shower, laundry facilities and pump out services available.We also provide dry rack boat storage and a 12,000 lbs. hoist. Our bait and tackle store can take care of all your fishing needs with plenty of advice for all you fisherman.Local restaurants are within a short walking distance of our docks.Your water sport adventures start here with overnight accommodations on one of our Trawlers or Sportfisherman boats, kayak rentals and Charter boat fishing are available and ask about a combination deal of "stay and play".

marinas.name: Little River Marina
marinas.about: About Every year millions of people take advantage of the recreational opportunities Lake Allatoona provides. One reason for all the visitors is the fact there is a lot of lake to enjoy. When it is full Lake Allatoona covers more than 12,000 acres and has 270 miles of shoreline. The lake and much of the land that surrounds it are managed by the U.S. Army Corp of Engineers. It is considered one of the best lakes in Georgia, and Glade and Little River Marinas are the best marinas on Lake Allatoona. The lake is located on the Etowah River, a tributary of the Coosa River, about 30 miles north of Atlanta.

marinas.name: Carters Lake Marina & Resort
marinas.about: Carters Lake Marina & Resort is a full service marina located in the North West Georgia mountains, midway between Atlanta and Chattanooga. We offer covered slips from 24 to 80ft. Carters Lake is an inland lake, 3200 acres in size with 62 miles of shoreline and 465 ft deep at the dam. The marina has cabin rentals ( which include a boat slip at the marina), pontoon boat rentals, ships store, seasonal restaurant , on water gas sales and boat repair and maintenance (for slip customers).
