Hogan's Marina
marinas.about: About Hogans' Marina is a dry rack, wet storage, and launching marina facility on Turner's Creek. We are located at 36 Wilmington Island Road right next door to Publix Supermarket. We have undergone two major expansions over the past few years and now have 272 dry rack spaces, over 1100 linear feet of dock space, and 2 forklift trucks. We have expanded our Marine Store, added a wide variety of merchandise and fishing tackle and have improved other aspects of service such as adding a pump out facility. Please call or drop an e-mail if you have questions.

marinas.name: Bull River Marina
marinas.about: Looking for Seasonal or Annual Dockage? Bull River Marina sits on the Bull River on the eastern side of Wilmington Island, GA. (N 32′ 02.086″ by W 080′ 57.557″). We are a deep water marina that’s able to provide short-term as well as long-term dockage for your vessel. With a complete remodel and expansion in 2013, we can handle almost any boaters’ needs. Bull River Marina is in the middle of boating & fishing paradise and we offer a wide range of services to accommodate your needs. We have rental boats that can be used to strike out on your own and explore the fishing and natural beauty of the area. We offer excursions to Shark Tooth Island to find fossil shark teeth, including the mighty Megalodon! Take our Water taxi to Daufuskie for a tour of the island and great food. We also offer sunset cruises, beach drops, and downtown Savannah tours by water. Our boater's lounge is an excellent place to hang out. Locally owned and operated, Bull River Marina is ideally nestled on the eastern s

marinas.name: 15th Street Marina Marathon at Boot Key Harbor
marinas.about: The 15th Street Marina is located at the southern end of Marathon on the ocean side adjacent Boot Key Harbor. We have 25 recreational slips, commercial fisherman slips, as well as an on-site bait & tackle shop.

marinas.name: Key West City Marina at Garrison Bight
marinas.address: 1801 N Roosevelt Blvd, Key West, FL 33040
marinas.about: City Marina's 245 slips straddle the Palm Avenue causeway in Garrison Bight. On the north side of the island in Key West, the marina is the home of The Key West Historic Charter Boat Row. City Marina has slips available for live-aboard, recreational and transient customers along with our 149-ball Mooring Field. Please go to our website and make an online reservation request at https://www.citymarinakeywest.com/egov/apps/action/center.egov?view=form;page=1;id=2

marinas.name: Bay Palms Waterfront Resort & Marina - St Pete Beach
marinas.address: 4237 Gulf Blvd, St. Pete Beach, FL 33706
marinas.about: Bay Palms Waterfront Resort – Hotel and Marina is an award winning boutique resort of only 15 rooms and 9 Marina slips located directly on Boca Ciega Bay. Bay Palms boasts one of the largest privately owned fishing piers in St. Petersburg (1500 square feet!) where you can fish, dock your vessel, and meet Florida’s sea creatures like manatees or dolphins! Bay Palms is also pet friendly, meaning that you can bring the entire family for a vacation you’ll remember for a lifetime. With a beautiful pool overlooking the Boca Ciega Bay, the Bay Palms Waterfront Resort is the best destination for relaxation; and best of all, Bay Palms is only 200 feet from the beach. After a fresh renovation just last year, The Bay Palms is sure to wow you with clean spacious rooms with kitchenettes, and separate bedrooms. We’ve also installed a brand new dock on the water with beautiful lights for a great spot to unwind day or night. Try us and see why so many people come back year after year. Voted Best Marin

marinas.name: Safe Harbor Emerald Coast
marinas.address: 115 John Sims Pkwy West, Niceville, FL 32578-5044
marinas.about: Our region is richly blessed with the most spectacular emerald waters and powder-white sand beaches anywhere in the world. We are honored to serve as your direct gateway to this breathtaking boating mecca. We are ideally located in Niceville, Florida, at the northern point of the Choctawhatchee Bay, just minutes from the Destin Harbor, Crab Island and the Intracoastal Waterway. Emerald Coast Marine Center is your local boat dealership, proud to serve the Emerald Coast. We are dedicated to providing superior customer service in all aspects of our operation, while inspiring lifelong memories for you and your guests, both oceanside and dockside. Unlike other boating facilities, our total focus is customer-centric. When you become a customer of Emerald Coast Marine Center, you are fully embraced and welcomed into our family. Everything we do here is expressly designed to propel the best boating experience possible for you!

marinas.name: Cape Marina
marinas.about: Cape Marina is a second and third-generation, family-owned marina located in Port Canaveral. For 50 years, we have operated as a working waterfront facility, serving both recreational and commercial boaters with direct access to the ocean and the Intracoastal Waterway. We offer 115 four-pole fixed wet slips accommodating vessels from 15 to 65 feet in length. We also provide Floating Dock transient dockage for vessels up to 120 feet and beyond, with 24-hour access and quick departure to open water. In addition to wet slips, we provide: • Indoor and outdoor dry storage • Seven-day in-and-out rack service • A working DIY yard for owner-performed maintenance and projects Amenities include: • Clean, modern restrooms and showers • Washers and dryers • Gas and diesel fuel pumps • High-speed diesel fueling Dockwa is used primarily for Floating Dock reservations. Our four-pole fixed slips are generally for long-term slip customers and are typically not available for transient use, though we mak

marinas.name: Marker 8 Marina
marinas.about: Positioned at an important gateway into historic downtown St. Augustine, Marker 8 Hotel & Marina is the perfect location along the bayfront and has magnificent views of the downtown skyline. Through a series of intimate garden spaces, a cantilevered boardwalk, and a new poolscape, the design seeks to activate the waterfront edge and create a relaxing, yet high-end experience for guests. Marker 8 is the secret treasure just steps away from the famous historic district of St. Augustine Florida. Enjoy a unique stay with 26 elegant themed rooms, each with a unique view, rain showers, modern furnishings while savoring the best water front views in the City. If you are looking for luxury, panoramic view in the heart of St. Augustine, then Marker 8 Hotel & Marina is the place.

marinas.name: Twin Dolphin Marina
marinas.about: Nestled safely along the beautiful Manatee River in Bradenton, Fl. Twin Dolphin Marina is within walking distance of the historic downtown and it's quaint Old Main Street. The historic Bradenton Pier, centrally located within the marina is host to the famed Pier 22 Restaurant, Patio, and Ballroom where you can enjoy fine dining in a relaxed atmosphere . Come and enjoy the best of what the Gulf Coast has to offer. Enjoy a scenic and tranquil getaway in the heart of Bradenton, FL. Great dining and shopping abound in the warm and inviting atmosphere of the historical downtown area. Visit Pier 22 for casual or fine dining in a relaxed setting.

marinas.name: Stuart Corinthian Yacht Club
marinas.address: 4725 South East Capstan Avenue, Stuart, FL 34997
marinas.about: The Stuart Corinthian Yacht Club (SCYC) is the treasure coast’s premier destination for friendship and fun both on and off the water. Our member-owned club has a 25-year history honoring the long-standing traditions of yacht clubs across the country. Our members enjoy an active social calendar and share a commitment to our community and the causes that affect our marine and boating lifestyle. Our casually elegant waterfront clubhouse and marina provide the perfect location for sharing fun-filled days and warm evenings with friends. The Club is ideally located at the southeastern end of the Manatee Pocket in historic Port Salerno. Our marina allows for direct access to the Intracoastal Waterway for North/South cruising, bridge-free access to the St. Lucie Inlet and easy access to the Okeechobee Waterway for cruising to the West Coast of Florida. Fuel truck deliveries can be arranged through Dockside Fuel Service. 200 gallon minimum,772-485-4988.

marinas.name: Cypress Cove Marina
marinas.about: Cypress Cove Marina sits at the heart of Clermont chain of lakes. We offer a wide range of marina services including annual, covered wet slip rental. Cypress Cove Marina is situated on Lake Minnehaha on the Clermont Chain of Lakes which includes Lake Louisa, Lake Minnehaha and Lake Minneola. Enjoy all your favorite water sports, boating, sunset watching, fishing and wakeboarding. Our adjacent tiny home community offers fully furnished vacation rentals. Email us for more details at manager@cypresscoveclermont.com or call 352-364-9798.

marinas.name: Legacy Harbour Marina
marinas.address: 2044 West First Street, Fort Myers, FL 33901-3109
marinas.about: Legacy Harbour Marina: Honoring the Past, Building the Future - Coming Soon! For decades, Legacy Harbour Marina has been a beloved homeport for boaters traveling Florida’s west coast. Located along the Caloosahatchee River just steps from historic downtown Fort Myers, the marina was known for its welcoming community, beautiful sunsets, and prime location along the Okeechobee Waterway. Longtime visitors recall the bustling docks, on-site amenities, and easy access to local restaurants and shops. These qualities made Legacy Harbour a favorite stop for both seasonal and year-round boaters. Construction began in early 2025, and the marina is projected to reopen in Q1 2026. AIRN Management has spent the past three years clearing the site and preparing for reconstruction following Hurricane Ian. Bellingham Marine, the global leader in marina design and construction, is providing its Unifloat® concrete wave attenuator system and Unideck® aluminum frame dock system for the redevelopment.

marinas.name: Treasure Island Marina
marinas.address: 3605 South Thomas Drive, Panama City Beach, FL 32408
marinas.about: Treasure Island Marina is Northwest Florida’s premier on-the-water storage, parts and service facility. Family owned and operated for over 40 years, we have everything you are looking for in a full service marina. Our fuel dock is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. And we have a couple of storage options available for your boat of any size: dry stack inside storage and in the water slips are both offered.

marinas.name: Dockside Marina and Resort
marinas.address: 1160 Seaway Drive, South Hutchinson Island, FL 34949
marinas.about: Dockside Marina and Resort has been family owned and operated for over 25 years, so we understand single travelers to full families and big groups. Because Dockside Inn is located on one of the finest deep water inlets on the east coast of Florida, the vacation opportunities are endless. We respectfully request that children ages 16 and under be supervised while in the marina. Life jackets are a must. No swimming, jumping off the docks, no kayaks, no paddle boards or diving inside the marina. Due to the size of our slips and the current we do not accept boats smaller than 17 feet. Anglers love returning to Dockside Marina and Resort because they can catch their next trophy fish. Whether you are fishing for snook, grouper, snapper, sand perch or bigger fish in the deep waters, Fort Pierce is a great staring point. Families frequent Dockside Marina and Resort because of all of the amenities that are offered at the resort: two large swimming pools, are pet-friendly, all-day coffee, bait a

marinas.name: Coffee Bluff Marina
marinas.about: Coffee Bluff Marina is conveniently located on the southside of Savannah in a scenic, historic and quiet setting away from traffic and congestion. Coffee Bluff Marina is a full service marina. We currently sell fuel, live bait, frozen bait, fishing tackle, hats, T-shirts, ice and concessions. The newly constructed marina has a brand new boat hoist rated for 20,000 lbs and state-of-the-art extra-wide cement floating docks. Wet slips are available for nightly, monthly or yearly lease as well as dry storage. The marina also has brand new aluminum ramps for easy dock access including a handicap ramp that offers very relaxed slopes at all tides. The marina currently carries ethanol free marine gas, which is available at a pump on the docks as well as a pump on land. Diesel fuel is also available on the dock.

marinas.name: Town of Palm Beach Marina
marinas.about: The only public marina on the island of Palm Beach, the Town Marina has been providing berthing for power and sail yachts up to 260’ in length since the 1940s. Just north of the Everglades Golf Course, the Town Marina is newly reconstructed and officially open! The brilliant new marina works in harmony with the Town’s ethos, style and quality of life. It includes a $34 million renovation and improvements to transform the old Town Docks into a world-class yacht center that will welcome vessels from 60 to 294 feet. The Town Marina is centrally located and only a short distance away from West Palm Beach, which has a multitude of fine restaurants, bars and shops. Our island location places you within walking distance of the world-famous Worth Avenue. For those looking to leave their yacht and travel further afield, the marina is closely located to main transport links including I-95 and the Palm Beach International Airport, and railways to Delray Beach, Boca Raton, Fort Lauderdale and Miam

marinas.name: Clearwater Harbor Marina
marinas.about: The Clearwater Harbor Marina is a beautiful marina with state-of-the-art concrete floating docks located in the Downtown District of Clearwater, Florida just across from Coachman Park. The boat slips are accessible from the Intracoastal Waterway at the Memorial Causeway Bridge and are part of Downtown Clearwater’s Cleveland Street Retail and Entertainment District featuring numerous shops, restaurants and art galleries. There is a one-time $10.00 non-refundable fee associated with each reservation. There is a three (3) night minimum charge for stays during the Super Boat Races, Clearwater Jazz Holiday, and Clearwater Celebrates America 4th of July events. We will begin taking reservation requests at 8:00 a.m. on the day falling exactly six (6) weeks before the event’s start date. 50AMP & 100AMP power available (splitters may be available upon request). There is absolutely NO fueling allowed within the Clearwater Harbor Marina.

marinas.name: The Boca Raton
marinas.address: 501 East Camino Real, Boca Raton, FL 33432
marinas.about: Full-Service Marina, A 30-slip marina accommodates motor & sailing vessels up to 150 feet. On the Water From Harborside offerings on Lake Boca Raton, to days spent Beachside, water activities include boating and sailing, paddle boarding and kayaking, surf lessons, snorkeling and Yamaha WaveRunner outings. Charter boat excursions are available for deep-sea fishing and group drift fishing. CLUB & RESORT: The Boca Raton provides a year-round escape for Club Members and overnight Resort Guests (the property is not open to the general public). Five distinct hotels set within the luxury resort include Beach Club, Bungalows, Cloister, Tower and Yacht Club. Amenities range from a private golden beach, to 50,000-square-foot Spa Palmera, 18-hole golf course, 30-slip marina, Racquet Club with 16 tennis courts and four pickleball courts, retail boutiques, two pool clubs, Banyan Bunch children’s club, two fitness clubs, and wellness collaborations. The Boca Raton Club offers exclusive membership co

marinas.name: Galati Yacht Basin
marinas.address: 900 South Bay Blvd., Anna Maria, FL 34216
marinas.about: Located at the northernmost tip of beautiful Anna Maria Island, our deep-water marina offers a protected yacht basin just minutes from the Gulf of America, with no bridge delays. We welcome transient slips and visiting yachts up to 90’, providing an ideal stopover or home port for your time on Florida’s Gulf Coast. Our facilities include gas & diesel fuel, 50 Amp power at each slip, clean showers, and a fully stocked ship store with marine supplies, refreshments, and essentials. Enjoy a meal at Ocean Star www.islandoceanstarfl.com, the on-site sushi restaurant overlooking the harbor—perfect for relaxing after a day on the water. Just a short stroll away, you’ll find award-winning beaches, charming local shops, and a variety of waterfront restaurants serving everything from fresh seafood to casual island fare. Whether you’re cruising through, refueling, or planning an extended stay, Galati Yacht Basin's Marina combines modern amenities, friendly service, and prime waterfront access to m

marinas.name: Parrot Cove Marina
marinas.about: Parrot Cove Marina is a fenced and gated deep water marina that can accommodate boats up to 65’ long and catamarans up to 30’ wide. The marina is in a great location close to and with fast easy access to the Gulf of Mexico, Tampa Bay, Sarasota Bay and the intra-coastal waterway. Parrot Cove Marina is a small peaceful “old Florida” style marina. All of our boat slips have water, waste pump out and electrical hookups with meters as well as WiFi. Located in a well protected location on calm tranquil Palma Sola Bay where we don’t get any big wave action, resulting in less wear and tear on your boat and less rocking and rolling when you are on you boat.

marinas.name: Skipjack Resort Suites & Marina
marinas.about: Sail into Skipjack through the beloved Boot Key Harbor and dock your boat at our exclusive private Marina in Marathon Florida Keys. The Skipjack Marina has 54 rental slips, a boat ramp, and dock space that can accommodate up to 60 feet long on the Finger pier slips and up to 65 foot yachts on the Seawall. Skipjack Marina has fresh water, pump-out service, 30 & 50 amp power, Laundry, Cable TV, Wi-Fi, Pool, Bar, Restaurant, Showers, bathroom facilities, Fitness Center and the marina is well equipped to handle your nautical needs. Publix and stores located within walking distance. To book your slip, call 305-289-7662 or email dawn@skipjackresort.com.

marinas.name: Salty Sam's Marina
marinas.address: 2500 Main St, Fort Myers Beach, FL 33931
marinas.about: Salty Sam’s Marina is a full-service waterfront village and boating destination on Fort Myers Beach, offering something for boaters, locals, and visitors alike. From wet slips and state-of-the-art dry storage to experienced dock staff ready to assist, Salty Sam’s makes arriving by boat easy and stress-free with modern floating concrete docks and a protected basin. Explore the endless oceanfront destinations throughout Bradenton, unwind at the Jimmy Buffett themed restaurant & grill, or savor a stunning sunset view over Anna Marina Sound.

marinas.name: Hall of Fame Marina
marinas.about: Some things in life are better just because they are. They're simpler and easier, benefiting the tastes of those who have come to appreciate the finer things. Hall of Fame Marina is such a place. It's home port for the seasoned yachtsman, and the point from which to discover exciting possibilities. Hall of Fame is a gateway to the vast and varied pleasure of life on the beautiful south coast in Florida. So, whether you're in the mood for a cruise, sailing or sport fishing, a dive among the reefs, or a night on the town, you'll find this the perfect place to begin. Of course, that's exactly the way Hall of Fame is intended. Quality is evident in all we do at Hall of Fame Marina. And you're the reason why. We want your stay with us to be an unparalleled experience in yachting, and we'll do everything we can to ensure your satisfaction.

Guests can enjoy other marina amenities including use of our boat ramp, trailer parking, showers, pool and more. Learn more about our on-site marina and get in touch with our team with any questions. Looking to rent short-term space in our marina? Please use Dockwa or call the Dock Master at (305) 710-4193 for assistance. The monthly rate cannot be prorated. Up-to-Date Registration and $300,000 minimum liability boat insurance documentation is required before reservations can be confirmed or use of the boat launch.

When you rent from us, you'll have 24 hour access to your boat and all the adventures that await. Give us a call or book online today!

The completed development site will have 251 parking spaces and plenty of room for the variety of uses on the property. The project is anticipated to break ground in the Fall of 2019. The development site is less than a mile from the beach, 35 minutes from Tampa International Airport and 25 minutes from St. Pete / Clearwater International Airport. The project will be a true destination location for vacationers, boaters, restaurant goers and local residents. Some unique property features include a large outdoor waterfront event space that will allow the property to host concerts, markets and community gatherings. We offer Yacht Management services as required, including wash and detailing, mechanical repairs We are within walking distance to Downtown Stuart, which offers several highly rated restaurants and a wide variety of interesting shops. Many restaurants offer night time music entertainment as well. There is also a Downtown Tram that can take you back and forth as well. We are located adjacent to the Sunset Bay Marina, which offers gas and free pump-out service.

marinas.name: PORT 32 Tierra Verde
marinas.about: Located just off the Pinellas Bayway, convenient to both Tampa and St. Petersburg, and only minutes from prime offshore fishing, PORT 32 Tierra Verde is an exceptional location for boating and entertainment. Featuring a resort-style marina with an on-site pool and restaurant, PORT 32 Tierra Verde answers boaters every need.

Passing red marker 35.

marinas.name: Bradenton Beach Marina
marinas.about: We are a full service service resort marina located just off the Intracoastal Waterway on beautiful Anna Maria Island. Centrally located between Tampa Bay and Sarasota Bay, we are just minutes from the Gulf of Mexico via Longboat Pass. We are a family owned and operated business, established in 1982. We are committed to meeting the needs of our resident and visiting boaters.

marinas.name: Point South Marina at Port St. Joe
marinas.address: 340 Marina Drive, Port St Joe, FL 32456
marinas.about: Point South Marina is located in the heart of Florida’s Forgotten Coast, on the eastern shore of St. Joseph Bay between Panama City and Apalachicola, Florida. Port St. Joe is a favorite location for boaters to explore the pristine St. Joseph Bay, make their way along Florida’s Intracoastal Waterway, or head out into the Gulf of Mexico. It’s a major landmark in a small town and a hub of activity for locals and visitors alike. The design of the newly rebuilt Point South Marina at Port St. Joe features dry stack storage, wet-boat slips, a 300-foot transient dock, and the Point South Marina’s Outfitter Shop, where boaters can stock up on essentials ranging from cold beer, drinks and ice to Point South Marina merchandise and items from big brands like Yeti and Toadfish. Point South is bringing vibrant, sporting life back to Port St. Joe with its newest marina, centered around connecting members to the water and unforgettable service and unparalleled amenities. Whether you’re looking to dock

marinas.name: Sanford Boat Works & Marina
marinas.about: Sanford Boat Works & Marina is a boating tradition on the St. John’s River. Started by the Brumley and Smith families in 1925, the marina has continually provided boat slips in a natural harbor, experienced boat repair, and a friendly atmosphere for boaters. With 162 slips, Sanford Boat Works is able to store boats from 15 ft. to 64 ft. There are a variety of sizes and styles, both covered and uncovered. There is something to fit every boaters need. With competitive pricing, docking your boat at Sanford Boat Works & Marina is one of the best bargains on the river!

marinas.name: Mizner Marina
marinas.about: PLEASE NOTE -We have a 90 day MINIMUM LEASE TERM ON ALL LEASES, NO EXCEPTIONS. -There is a 13' fixed bridge prior to entering our marina. -We have a 12,000 lb. total weight limit on our rack storage. -All leases are month to month after the initial 90 days conclude.

marinas.name: Waterline Marina Resort & Beach Club, Autograph Collection
marinas.about: Plan a waterside rendezvous at Waterline Marina Resort & Beach Club, or arrive on your own. Disembark the boat and shake off your sea legs. Enjoy access to our restaurant and bar, Eliza Ann's Coastal Kitchen. Chill out and stay awhile with daily specials and happy hours. If you’re part of a traveling flotilla, stock up with provisions at the Dock Master's Office to keep your crew happy and avoid a possible mutiny. We offer 50 slips for boats up to 30 feet, and can accommodate overnight, weekly or monthly stays. So tie a bowline at Waterline and make us your waterfront destination. Please note: The City of Holmes Beach does not permit guests to sleep on their boats while docked overnight in the marina.

marinas.name: Hinckley Yacht Services - Stuart
marinas.about: Located in the historic Manatee Pocket, a yachting destination renowned for its sport fishing and “old Florida” feel, our Stuart boatyard has been serving the needs of discriminating Hinckley and non-Hinckley boat owners for decades. Over its years of operation and service, it has developed a reputation for superior marine carpentry, paint, fiberglass, hull, and engine repair work.

marinas.name: BG Bayside Marina
marinas.about: BG’s Surfside Grill and Adventures is the official concessionnaire for Sebastian Inlet State Park. Sebstian Inlet is home to the premier saltwater fishing spot on Florida’s east coast, this park is a favorite for anglers nationwide for catching snook, redfish, bluefish and Spanish mackerel from its jetties. Surfing is also a popular recreation and several major competitions are held here every year. Two museums provide a history of the area. The McLarty Treasure Museum features the history of the 1715 Spanish treasure fleet; the Sebastian Fishing Museum tells the history of the area’s commercial fishing industry. Three miles of beautiful beaches provide opportunities for swimming, eco-tours, shelling, and sunbathing. Kayaking in the Indian River Lagoon are also favorite pastimes. Visitors can relax with a stroll down the mile-long Hammock Trail. Waterfront pavilions and picnic areas are great for family outings. A campground for RVs in the South end of the park and tent camping at the

marinas.name: Sebastian Saltwater Marina and Lodge
marinas.about: Whether you're looking for a relaxing weekend or an action-packed fishing charter, Capt'n Butcher's has something for you. Located in Sebastian, Florida on the Indian River, Capt'n Butcher's is just minutes from the Sebastian Inlet. We offer waterfront lodging and a number of different fishing charters... everything you need for your next vacation! Plan on staying overnight? Ask about our lodging/fishing packages!

marinas.name: Adventure Coast Marina
marinas.about: Adventure Coast Marina is beautifully located in Hernando Beach. Our well protected location and state of the arm docks provide a premier experience for our customer. Come and stay to see for yourself!

marinas.name: EPIC Marina
marinas.about: EPIC Marina is a deep water marina featuring over 450 feet of linear dock space right in downtown Miami, FL. It's one of Miami's preferred marinas for yachts of all sizes. There are no bridges blocking you from accessing Biscayne Bay or the Atlantic Ocean, giving you easy access to the city. We feature an onsite luxury hotel and restaurant for you to enjoy. There are many great restaurants within walking distance including the Kaseya Center to see the Miami Heat play or any number of concerts and events held there!!

marinas.name: Conch Key Fishing Lodge and Marina
marinas.address: 3 North Conch Ave, Conch Key, FL 33050
marinas.about: Come and enjoy our finger pier-docks! Our boat slips can accommodate up to a 32′ boat with 12′ widths, and up to 4′ depths, and we have a single boat ramp capable of accommodating up to a 32′ boat. We even sell non-ethanol fuel (Rec 90) at the ramp. We always have plenty of tables and chairs for the cocktail hour get-together, and you can enjoy our panoramic view of the Gulf of Mexico while sitting back on our deck, under the Tiki Hut, or floating in our salt water pool. Only seconds across the water from our motel (probably before the time you plane-out your boat!) is the Long Key Bridge that gives our guests easy access to the ocean side for world-class fishing.

marinas.name: Marsh Harbor Marina
marinas.about: A family owned and operated full service boatyard in Palmetto, Florida since 1998. Fourstroke Verado and Optimax specialists service the latest in Mercury Outboard technology. Inboard and Sterndrive specialists service the latest in Mercruiser and Volvo Penta Emission-Controlled Catalyst technology.

Spend some time relaxing by the pool. Our goal is for you to enjoy your stay! ​Price $2.50 per foot regardless of the length of vessel. Two linear docks. North dock has three power pedestals and the depth runs 5-6 ft. The South dock has four power pedestals and the depth runs from 7-10+ feet.

marinas.name: Hidden Harbor Marina
marinas.about: Hidden Harbor Marina is a premier high and dry marina facility in Sarasota, Florida, offering secure monthly & annual indoor/outdoor dry rack storage, as well as in house sales & service provided by Quality Boats. Our prime South Sarasota location, just off U.S. 41, provides unparalleled access to the stunning waters of the newly "re-opened" Midnight Pass, The Gulf of America, Sarasota Bay, and much more! Boaters love our location for its diverse array of boating opportunities, such as exceptional fishing, ease of access to sandbars, and waterfront restaurants! Hidden Harbor Marina is located directly in between channel markers 50 & 51 on the ICW! (Mainland/East Side) We're not just about storage; we're about enhancing your entire boating experience. Our goal is to make boating easy with our online reservation system to ensure your vessel is always launched on time including any additional items such as fuel and ice you may request! After your day of fun on the water, when the vessel i

marinas.name: Drop Anchor Resort and Marina
marinas.about: Drop Anchor Resort & Marina is a Florida Keys vacation resort located at MM85 on Windley Key in Islamorada. We are very proud of our history and have been a landmark in Islamorada for over 50 years. While we do aspire to keep the "old keys" spirit alive at our resort, providing updated rooms and amenities for our guests' comfort is one of our top priorities. Our rooms are among the most immaculate in the Florida Keys. Towering and inspiring palm trees cover our beautiful pool and beach area which lead up to our Oceanside dock. This makes for a relaxing time in-between visiting your choice of Florida Keys attractions. We have a boat ramp and dockage available to our guests. Located in the "Fishing Capital of the World", we are within a few miles of the best dining and watersports establishments in the Florida Keys.

Our goal at PORT 32 is to enhance your boating experience with a service-first approach and first-class amenities.

marinas.name: Square Grouper Tiki Bar and Marina
marinas.about: Square Grouper Tiki Bar and Marina is located on the Jupiter Inlet and provides both transient and longer term dockage along with a lively Tiki Bar and restaurant. Stop in and put your feet in the sand while you listen to live music and enjoy a cold drink. Beautiful views of the inlet and Jupiter Lighthouse have locals and tourists coming back. The marina welcomes boats over 63' and offers 50 and 100 amp connections along with other amenities.

The marina offers numerous services on-site including a full service facility specializing in bottom painting, detailing and repairs, as well as boat storage for hurricane protection during season. Nearby, boaters will be able to cruise in calm, clear water, find restaurants and bars, and some of the cleanest beaches in the country!

marinas.name: The Marine Supply & Oil Company
marinas.about: Approach The Marine Supply & Oil Company is Northeast Florida's largest marine outlet. Since 1946 we have been serving the needs of pleasure boaters, sailors, fishermen and the commercial marine trades. Come browse our 32,000 sq. ft. warehouse. With more than 16,000 items in stock, we are sure to have the parts and products you need. And, if we don't have it in stock, we can usually have it the next day. As you know, experience is important, and when you have a question or problem you want the best advice possible. That's why Marine Supply is staffed with industry professionals that offer more than 100 years of marine related "know-how". We're right down the street or globally available to meet your marine supply needs. Visit us at Marine Supply & Oil Co.

marinas.name: Gilbane Boatworks
marinas.about: Gilbane Boatworks is home to Jupiter and Tequesta’s hidden jewel, the Black Pearl Marina. Our marina facility is equipped with 39 High Tide boat lifts and 3 wet slips able to accommodate vessels up to 45ft dry and 65ft wet. Our High Tide boat lifts range from 9,000lbs to 30,000lbs. Gilbane Boatworks is family owned and run by a great staff who’s main focus is catering to the comfort and needs of our members. Members can enjoy premium service as well as the privacy of a small marina that is equipped with all the essentials. Our slip rentals include water and electric, free ice, gated tenant parking, use of water-front patio and outside bar and grill. The marina facility is equipped with high security and lockable lifts. marinas.about: Welcome to our web site. Briefly, we are a full service marina and boat yard. The marina has been around since 1903. Some would say we have history on our side. The role of the marina has changed over the hundred plus years of its existence. Initially, it had been used as a transportation hub for the east coast, as well as a base camp for intracoastal waterway construction. It has also been a site of naval ship building during and around World War Two, later for race boat construction, and commercial and pleasure fishing boat building. Currently and over its modern history as a boutique marina and a yard that specializes on refurbishing pleasure boats. We are locally owned and operated and offer many modern amenities. The marina is conveniently located in downtown Daytona Beach on the west side of the Halifax River. The staff are one of the friendliest on the east coast. We are a short walk to the Downtown Daytona shopping district. Our marina is in a safe harbor open year round that o

marinas.name: Grassy Key Marina
marinas.about: Centrally located on the Keys, Grassy Key Marina offers boaters multiple services to make their stay as enjoyable as possible. Indoor and outdoor storage options for either your vessel or trailer or both, Paradise Boat & Jet Ski rental company on premise and a fully stocked mini market are just some of the amenities that we available to our boaters. Visiting yachtsmen are offered many amenities. Sit and relax under the Tiki Hut attached to The Saunder's Landing Restaurant, enjoy the well-stocked grocery/general store with bakery, large selection of wines, marine supplies, Fax Service, UPS Delivery, hardware, live bait and fishing supplies. We also have a laundry, hair salon, resort wear boutique on site. Ocean swimming and Hotels are across A1A from Nettles Island Marina. All stores and services located on dockside.

marinas.name: Newcastle Shipyard
marinas.about: In 1999, Kevin Keith along with Lester Miller, a prominent US businessman formed Newcastle Marine, Inc. Their goal was to create a company dedicated to building high quality, ocean-going motoryachts. Their first mission was to find a suitable location. An existing shipyard in Palm Coast, Florida was purchased and completely rebuilt. A new six story construction building, slipway/bulkheading, and a 1,000-ton marine railway system capable of hauling and launching up to 200 feet in length are among the many improvements to the facility. Intrigued by the growing worldwide demand for "Expedition" type yachts, it was decided Newcastle's first build would be the "Newcastle Explorer". This 102' Expedition Yacht was extremely well received at the 2001 Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show and subsequently sold one month after the show. "Newcastle Explorer" has since been around the world several times and gained much notoriety by surviving the Tsunami and rescuing many of the waves survivors.

marinas.about: Harborage Marina's newest addition is our Salt Creek dock. 341' of fixed dock that is extremely well protected from weather events. Located in downtown St Petersburg, our facility offers ample parking and easy access to boundless area attractions. Unwind by the resort-style pool, or meet up with friends for a BBQ and cocktails at our casual Tiki Hut. Come evening, catch up with boating neighbors at one of our regular members events, visit the Big Catch on Salt Creek for lunch or dinner, or dine at one of St. Petersburg’s many fine restaurants.

marinas.name: Georgia Boys Marina
marinas.about: We invite you to enjoy our little bit of paradise on the banks of Dunns Creek, nestled between the St. Johns River and Crescent Lake. Bring your boat and spend the weekend, or fish off our dock out in the creek! Our boat ramp and canal provide you a clear path to the river where both fresh and saltwater fish practically jump into your boat! Breathe easy and enjoy the peaceful sights and sounds of nature. See turtles sunning on logs, manatees blowing, gators sleeping on the banks, and eagles and egrets flying low across the river. Take a dip at the Sandbar in the middle of the St Johns River, Putnam County’s very own version of the “Redneck Riviera.” Known as the "Fishing Headquarters" of Florida, you'll never go away empty-handed! The water is full of bass, bream, catfish, speckled perch, and so much more. Florida freshwater fishing is at its best at Georgia Boys Fish Camp.

marinas.name: Windward at St. Augustine Shipyard
marinas.about: St. Augustine Shipyard, located on the San Sebastian River, a 10 - minute cruise from the inlet. St. Augustine Shipyard offers a modern dry storage facility with CAT 4 hurricane rated dry storage barn. The marina offers 275 dry storage slips and 15 lift slips, with future plans of expansion. Our convenient location offers easy access to nearby restaurants and businesses.

marinas.name: Williams Island Marina
marinas.about: Located in Aventura, Florida, midway between Miami and Fort Lauderdale, Williams Island Marina is a high-end marina with 106 total wet slips. The marina is constructed of fixed and floating concrete docks and can accommodate vessels up to 140’ in length. As part of the greater master-planned Williams Island community of over 2,000 residents, marina boaters can access numerous amenities, including indoor and outdoor pools, fitness centers, tennis courts, and food & beverage options.

marinas.about: Welcome to Pepper Marine. Full service dry stack boat storage. Let us take care of your boat, so you can spend your time on the water. Unlimited launches and retrievals. Maintenance, repairs, and fueling. Boat rentals available.

marinas.name: Coquina Marina
marinas.about: Searching, high and low, for a boat slip rental from Palm Coast to New Smyrna Beach—look no further! We have slips available at our luxury, Daytona Beach marina, located at mile marker 32 on the west bank of the beautiful, Intracoastal Waterway. Just south of the Seabreeze Bridge in the heart of Daytona Beach, Coquina Marina has 61 boat slips that come fully equipped with electricity and water, and can accommodate yachts up to 90 ft. Plus, our experienced and friendly Harbormaster is on-hand to assist you with all your boating needs. But, that’s not all! Coquina Marina is known for having luxury amenities and the best rates in Daytona Beach! Our guests can enjoy a relaxing day by our beautiful pool and spa, work-out in our fitness center, play a match on our tennis courts, use our laundry facilities, and so much more! Whether your stay with us will be on a daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal, or annual rental, we want our Daytona marina to be your home-away-from-home.

marinas.name: Hontoon Island State Park
marinas.about: This island, located in the St. Johns River in Volusia County, welcomes visitors to enjoy nature and history in quiet solitude. The island is accessible only by private boat or park ferry. Evidence of Native American habitation over thousands of years can be witnessed as visitors hike through the park. Stop in and walk through the impressive visitor center to learn more about the many inhabitants and uses of Hontoon Island over the years. Boating, canoeing, and fishing are popular activities and canoe rentals are available. Picnic areas include tables, grills, and a playground. Overnight boat slip rentals are also available. The park's ferry operates daily from 8:00 a.m. to one hour before sunset. Located six miles west of Deland off State Road 44.

marinas.name: Quality Inn Marina
marinas.about: Get real value at the pet-friendly Quality Inn & Suites® Riverfront hotel in Palatka, FL on the banks of the St. Johns River. Conveniently located in the heart of historic downtown, this Palatka hotel offers you real value for your hard-earned money. We give you easy access to Palatka Golf Club, Ravine Gardens State Park and such nearby points of interest as: David Browning Railroad Museum St. Johns River Community College Etoniah Creek State Forest Welaka State Forest Rodman Reservoir A fisherman’s paradise, Palatka hosts several state and international bass fishing tournaments throughout the year.

Our attentive team is always ready to assist, ensuring a smooth docking experience from arrival to departure. The LaBelle Yacht Club offers a one-of-a-kind experience to enhance your stay. Be sure to stop by our on-site bar and restaurant, The Launch, where you can enjoy your favorite cocktails and indulge in a full-service lunch or dinner in a relaxed, waterfront setting. Reminiscent of an old style Florida resort, Acosta Creek Harbor offers a safe haven for boaters, fishermen, or anyone looking for a peaceful get-away. There's plenty to do, as well. Fishing is great. In fact, the area has long been known as "the bass capital of the world." The river is ripe for exploring from the nature-rich Ocklawaha to the clear waters of Salt Springs and Silver Glen Springs. Nearby nature parks offer wonderful hiking trails, or you can simply relax. So come and experience Acosta Creek Marina and the St. Johns River.

Clearwater Beach Marina offers access to all boating activities. We are home to the finest fishing charters, sailing charters, sight-seeing boats, dinner cruises, dolphin tours, parasailing and personal watercraft. We also have restaurants, a gift shop, barber shop, laundry facilities, mini-mart and bait house. It is centrally located so you are close to shopping and entertainment venues. Clearwater Beach Marina has more than 200 slips and is open year-round. There are 23 slips available for transient boaters. We are equipped to accommodate vessels up to 125 feet.

marinas.name: Best Western Fort Myers Waterfront

marinas.name: Fish Island Marina
marinas.about: Fish Island Marina in Saint Augustine, Florida, is a quaint, rustic haven for boaters seeking a peaceful yet functional spot along the water with serene views of the intercoastal and the nearby 312 Bridge, this small marina is perfect for anyone looking to enjoy the beauty of St. Augustine and breathtaking sunsets. The marina itself has minimal commercial frills—no flashy amenities, just the basics—but that’s part of its charm. It’s a place to soak in the beauty of the water and you can occasionally spot a dolphin or manatee in the water. Appreciate the rich history of the area, all while anchored in a true Florida treasure. With less than 50 slips, Fish Island Marina is home to a mix of vessels—sailboats, fishing boats, catamarans—both private and commercial. The marina is outfitted with the essentials: onsite mechanics to assist with repairs, well-kept bathrooms for visitors, fish cleaning stations and an office that serves as the marina’s central hub. Soon, the addition of fuel serv

marinas.name: Morningstar Marinas | Mayport
marinas.about: High Speed Fuel Dock & Marina located only two miles from the St. John's River inlet and two miles from the Intracoastal Waterway. Our transient/fueling location is the perfect stop for a quick refuel or overnight stay. Along with the best diesel prices in North Florida, we offer after hours fueling, and discounts on fuel sales exceeding 1000 gallons. ATTENTION: We cater to volume after-hours fuel needs. Please call Andrew at (904) 568-8685 to schedule an after hours fuel sale. Come in and see us as we look forward to catering to your fuel and overnight transient needs.

marinas.name: Lighthouse Point Yacht Club
marinas.about: Welcome to Lighthouse Point Yacht Club Marina, a premier destination renowned for its exceptional maritime services and unparalleled boating experience. Strategically located just "a mere 1.5 nautical miles" from the prestigious Hillsboro Inlet, our marina is a hidden gem, catering to the discerning needs of year round boaters, yacht enthusiasts, and waterfront aficionados. Sea Tow Members get $0.25 cents off a foot per night for transient reservations. Please use the special request field to indicate your membership number and we will apply the discount.

marinas.name: Chokoloskee RV Resort & Marina
marinas.about: The Marina at Chokoloskee RV Park was fully redone in 2024. We’ve got 36 slips with power and water available by the day, week, or month for boats 30’ and under. From the docks, you’re a quick ride to the Ten Thousand Islands and Everglades backcountry—great water for snook, redfish, trout, and seasonal tarpon, plus miles of quiet mangrove creeks to explore. OVERNIGHT STAYS ON BOATS ARE NOT PERMITTED If you want to stay close to your boat, we also offer vacation rentals and RV sites just a short walk from the slips, so mornings start on the water and evenings end with an easy stroll back to your place. Boater will be charged for the remaining balance of reservation 14 days prior to arrival Please contact marina for first responder & veteran discount.

marinas.name: Cudjoe Gardens Marina
marinas.about: Cudjoe Gardens Marina is a family run eco-friendly marina located in the lower Florida Keys on the beautiful island of Cudjoe Key, mile marker 21. An excellent place to explore the keys from, our marina is located about half way between Key West and Marathon with easy access to both the Atlantic, the Gulf of Mexico and the back country. We are well located near Sugarloaf Key, Summerland Key, Big Pine Key, Bay Point, and many other islands which offer a variety of dining and shopping opportunities. We offer fishing, diving, kayak and boating adventures for the whole family. We have both deepwater and dry slips available and a deep boat ramp that can accommodate boats up to 40 foot. The waters for offshore, backcountry and blue water fishing are teaming with salfish, tuna, mahi mahi (dorado, dolphin), wahoo, grouper, a variety of snapper, yellow tail, mutton, red, mangrove, hogfish, tarpon, bonefish, and many other highly sought after fish for both sport and good eating. Call or stop in

marinas.name: Prime Catch Restaurant
marinas.address: 700 East Woolbright Road, Boynton Beach, FL 33435

marinas.name: Lauderdale Marina
marinas.about: Welcome to historic Lauderdale Marina, located along the inland waterway in the yachting capital of the world, Fort Lauderdale, Florida. We're one of the region's oldest family owned & operated marinas (established in 1948). Lauderdale Marina is prized for its enviable location just minutes from Port Everglades and the Atlantic Ocean. We're a full service marina featuring the award winning Fifteenth Street Fisheries waterfront restaurant, a 365 foot fuel dock with diesel, ethanol-free gas and dock store, Boston Whaler boat dealership, service department & parts department, and premium boat slips which can accommodate yachts up to 165 feet.

marinas.name: Rosen Park Marina
marinas.about: This neighborhood park and large saltwater boat launch facility offers access to the Gulf of Mexico via the Caloosahatchee River and is approximately 11.2 statute miles from the Sanibel Causeway Bridge. Each of the two boat ramps is 30' wide x 60' long and there are 57 boat trailer parking spots plus 31 vehicle parking spaces to accommodate a large number of boaters. In addition, Rosen Park houses 19 wet boat slips designed to handle vessels up to 40 feet in length which are available for annual and transient rentals. The park also provides a scenic location along the Chantry Canal where people can enjoy a picnic and/or take a walk on the boardwalk and watch the boats. Rosen Park can be accessed via boat by turning West at marker #58. Marine Services staff monitors VHF channel 16.

marinas.name: Harbour Cay Club
marinas.about: Sail into Paradise, you might just stay a while! Harbour Cay Club extends an invitation to anyone wishing to enjoy our unique maritime community. Although we are a private, non-commercial marina, we will welcome licensees when a slip is unoccupied by the member. So, spend the season, a month, or a week with us and enjoy the Florida Keys in adult live aboard convenience. Since our marina is owned and operated by the boaters who reside here, we have all the amenities you want when you stay on board. We are not a commercial marina but an adult community of boaters and, as such, we can concentrate on the beauty of our tropical paradise.

marinas.name: Waterways Marina
marinas.address: 12000 Gandy Blvd N, St Petersburg, FL 33702

marinas.name: Porkys Bayside Restaurant and Marina
marinas.about: In our marina - a minimum of 90 percent of the wet slips are open to the general public on the first-come first-serve basis. We are known for our good food and friendly island atmosphere. Our unique location has hosted famous Keys visitors and celebrities since the 1950's, including such notables as Ernest Hemmingway, Jimmy Hoffa and Elizabeth Taylor. Originally known as "Bill Thompson's Villas and Marina", it was the place to be. We know that it still is! Our BBQ is smoked daily on premises and we offer fresh local seafood. Share a bit of what the Keys used to be.

marinas.name: Bayside Marina
marinas.address: 6325 Big Daddy Dr, Panama City, FL 32407
marinas.about: NEW OWNERSHIP & BRAND NEW RENOVATIONS Bayside Marina is a one-stop shop for all your boating needs. We offer boat storage, valet service boat launching, non-ethanol fuel, an on-site mechanic, a pay-to-launch boat ramp, ice, and bait and tackle. We are known as one of the best marinas for fishermen due to our marina store offerings, our Killerdock fishing cleaning station, and our location. Our friendly and experienced staff are dedicated to providing you with excellent customer service, so you can relax and enjoy your day on the water.

marinas.name: Key Largo Fisheries Marina
marinas.address: 1313 Ocean Bay Dr Suite B, Key Largo, FL 33037

marinas.name: Moss Marina
marinas.address: 450 Harbor Ct, Fort Myers Beach, FL 33931
marinas.about: Moss Marina is located on Fort Myers Beach and serves all of SW Florida. We are a full service marina, that services and repairs all brands of boats. We offer boat rentals, refueling, wet slips, dry dock storage, a boater's lounge, laundry, showers, and a complete Ship's Store. We have been in operation since 1969. Our marina is customer friendly with full amenities, in a clean comfortable setting with experienced service technicians and staff. So whether you are a local or just boater passing through, come by and experience the best marina on Fort Myers Beach.

marinas.name: DOWNTOWN SANFORD MARINA
marinas.about: Lying along the St. Johns River on Lake Monroe, Downtown Sanford Marina offers a beautiful and seamless boating experience. Ours was the first marine facility in Florida to achieve Clean Marina, Clean Boatyard, and Clean Retailer designations—an accomplishment of which we will always be proud. On shore, the stunning Sanford RiverWalk meanders along both sides of the marina, and Historic Downtown Sanford’s shops and award-winning restaurants are only a few blocks away. Our central Florida location also allows easy access to the Orlando area’s world-famous attractions, Daytona, and beaches. Downtown Sanford Marina is also home to U-Sail of Central Florida and the St. Johns Rivership Company.

marinas.name: St Johns Marina & Resort
marinas.about: St. John’s Marina & Resort in DeLand, Florida, is situated on the 330-mile long St. John’s River, directly across from the Ocala National Forest. Famed for its bass fishing, St. Johns River is one of only 3 rivers in the nation that flows north and one of the “laziest” rivers in the world. Located only 30 miles from Orlando and 30 miles from Daytona Beach, St. John’s Marina enjoys spectacular seclusion and beauty making it an ideal escape from the busy lifestyle of the metropolitan city. The marina sits across from the Ocala National Forest which is the second largest National Forest in Florida and covers approximately 607 square miles (1570 km²) in central Florida. The Forest (established in 1908) is the oldest national forest east of the Mississippi River and the southernmost national forest in the continental U.S. Offering 50 acres of waterfront land and with 20 upland acres. St John's Marina is equipped with 30/50 amp pedestals at each slip. (Our slip numbers read left to right, NO

marinas.name: Shell Point Marina
marinas.address: 3340 W Shell Point Rd, Ruskin, FL 33570
marinas.about: Shell Point Marina, located at the end of the Little Manatee River, is the perfect Marina for any boater. With popular destinations like Tampa and St. Petersburg within easy reach. SPM has 45 wet slips, over 150 dry storage racks and a very active DIY Service Yard for boats up to 35 tons. The Marina can accommodate boats up to 60’ LOA, with a max beam of 16’ and a 6’ draft. Family owned and operated, Shell Point Marina is a boutique Marina featuring exceptional hospitality and amenities. Our recently completed pavilion features state of the art amenities to relax and enjoy after a day on the water.

marinas.name: Harborside Marina
marinas.about: 26 luxury, deep water boat slips make up the beautiful Harborside Marina community, adjacent to the Courtyard by Marriott Hotel in Madeira Beach, Florida. Amenities include gated access, on-site Dockmaster, water and electrical hookups and designated on-site parking. Slip owners may join and enjoy all the benefits of membership in the Captain's Club, including use of the hotel's pool, fitness center and private clubroom, plus discounts on food and beverages. Madeira Beach Municipal Marina is conveniently located nearby for diesel, unleaded and propane fuel, bait & tackle, and ships' store sundries. John's Pass, just 5 minutes by boat from Harborside Marina, provides easy access to the Gulf of Mexico.

marinas.name: Clearwater Beach Marina
marinas.address: 455 E Shore Dr, Clearwater Beach, FL 33767
marinas.about: Never a dull moment at the brand-new resort in the heart of Clearwater Beach! Note: Proof of $500,000 of insurance is required prior to arrival to the marina. Please input your carrier & amount during checkout. See policies for more details. The Clearwater Beach Marina is a newly opened marina right on Clearwater Bay in downtown Clearwater, next to the Courtyard by Marriott Clearwater Beach Hotel. You cannot beat this location surrounded by the best local shops, restaurants, bars, and beaches in Florida! The marina can accommodate vessels up to 60ft, with a max beam of 17ft and 20ft max draft. There is water available at every slip! For shore power, the marina offers options of 1x20, 1x30, and 2x30. If you require 1x50amp service, please book with 2x30amp shore power and bring a Reverse Y Adapter Splitter. Onsite, guests will find a restaurant and bar, snack shop, event space, and kayak, and paddleboard rentals. While on site, transient boaters will have access to hotel amenities such

marinas.name: Bristol Harbor Marina
marinas.address: 239 East Beach Drive, Panama City, FL 32401
marinas.about: Open to the public on a first-come first-serve basis, Bristol Harbor Marina is safely nestled in Massalina Bayou in the heart of downtown Panama City. Nice baths, free laundry and a pump out at every slip, it's perfect for a long term stay or a quiet overnight. Transients and loopers are all welcome. You'll absolutely love waking up in the sleepy little bayou, walking over to Bayou Joe's for a delightful breakfast and watching the dolphins get their exercise while you eat... all within sight of your yacht. You're also within walking distance of everything in downtown Panama City.

marinas.name: Lake Park Harbor Marina
marinas.address: 105 Lake Shore Dr, Lake Park, FL 33403
marinas.about: Lake Park Harbor Marina is located on the Intracoastal Waterway, just over a mile north of the Lake Worth/Palm Beach Inlet. It's the only municipal marina located in the Palm Beach County area that offers extended overnight trailer parking for boaters traveling to the Bahamas. The trip to West End Bahamas is approximately 60 nautical miles. Lake Park Harbor Marina's 112 boat slips are dispersed throughout an expansive dog friendly park setting. The quiet marina is relaxing with it's many benches, mature shade trees, tables and umbrellas. Be sure to take in a breathtaking sunrise over the Lake Worth Lagoon while visiting us. FEATURES: ~Docks Accomodate 30' to 80' Vessels ~Transient Dockage by Reservation ~Dual Boat Ramps ~Daily Trailer Parking ~Overnight Trailer Parking by Permit ~Fuel Dock Gasoline & Diesel ~Two (2) Pump-out Service Stations ~Ice, Water, Soft-drinks, Beer, and Frozen Bait ~30 or 50 Amp Electric Service ~Potable Water ~Wireless Internet ~Card Access to Tenant Restrooms

marinas.name: Naples City Dock
marinas.about: Come enjoy the completely rebuilt Naples City Dock. We offer deep water dockage and mooring balls for both transient and monthly guests. Our convenient location is close to shops and has amenities such as pump out, fuel, and restrooms.

marinas.about: A full service Florida marina located near Marker 72 on the St. Johns River near the N.E. corner of Big Lake George (The Bass Capital of the World). Deep water approach at GPS coordinates: N 29 degrees 22.794 and W 081 degrees 37.665. A full service marina featuring (non-Ethanol) Valvtec marine fuels, WI-FI hot spots, pump out, boat launch, laundry & shower facilities, comfortable dockage for boats up to 60' with 30 & 50 amp marine hookup available. Full bait & tackle store, fishing licenses, cold beer, cold drinks, ice cream, ice, snacks, etc., ship store with a large variety of marine items including marine batteries, filters & much more. Our marina has 7 clean, full efficiency cabins available with color cable TV, stove, fridge, microwave, toaster, coffee pot, linens, separate living room, kitchen, bath, bedroom & screened porch. Sleeps 4-8 guests depending on the unit. The MARINA has 33 RV sites with full hookup, 50 amp, 30 amp, 20 amp, cable TV, water, sewer & concrete patio. Four

marinas.name: City of Miami Marinas
marinas.about: The City of Miami owns and operates 4 conveniently located marine facilities. Miamarina Located in the heart of beautiful downtown Miami, on the Atlantic ICW at the west end of Government Cut, Miamarina is designed to accommodate yachtsmen and their vessels to 200' in our deep water slips. The marina was completely rebuilt and reopened in 1997, and our 130 slips were constructed with vessel safety and comfort in mind. Dockage is available on a transient, or long-term basis, or commercial basis and water and electricity usage is included in our rates. Miamarina is situated within the Bayside Marketplace, an internationally flavored assortment of over 100 stores, shops, restaurants, and cafes. Our marina is located next door to the American Airlines Arena, home of the NBA's Miami Heat, and just a short distance from such local attractions as South Beach, Miami Children's Museum, Parrot Jungle Island, and the Miami Seaquarium. Each February, Miamarina is proud host to the Strictly Sail ve

marinas.name: The Marina at Julington Creek
marinas.about: Julington Creek Pier 3 Marina And Dry Storage is located on Julington Creek, which flows into the St. Johns River, just south of I-295 on San Jose Boulevard in Jacksonville, Florida. There are over 70 slips on Pier 3 and availability is on a first-come basis. We provide boat storage services for boaters and sailors. We also offer RV storage at our off-site location on Mandarin Road. You can either rent a wet slip in our marina or request dry storage on a first-come, first-serve basis. Our inlet facility protects your vessels from storm damage, turbulence, and rough waters. Water and electrical hook-ups are also available for each slip. We have replaced all boards throughout the pier with better and more durable materials. We also have a clean restroom available for customers.

marinas.about: Private homes on the gulf coast island of North Captiva in the Sanibel and Captiva group.

marinas.name: Amara Cay Resort Dock
marinas.about: Islamorada is a true ocean playground—home to some of the world’s most unique and beautiful aquatic wildlife. As a guest of Amara Cay Resort, we welcome you to dock at our marina and explore the island’s brilliant turquoise waters by boat. Discover the Keys with Wild Dolphin Tours and Islamorada Spearfishing Adventures operating from our docks. Reserve your spot on a tropical excursion spent snorkeling or touring the Islamorada Sandbar, or pull up to our sister resort Three Waters Resort and Marina for more marina services, thrilling fishing charters, and wonderful waterfront drinks and dining. All dockage, boat ramp access, and boat trailer parking are reserved for resort guests with confirmed reservations. Our resorts do not launch or store jet skis.

marinas.name: Tierra Verde Resort Marina High & Dry
Fort Pierce Inlet Marina
marinas.about: Located on St. Lucie County's historic Hutchinson Island, the Fort Pierce Inlet Marina includes 39 boat slips with deepwater access, beautiful apartment accommodations and walking distance to shopping and other amenities.

marinas.name: Riviera Dunes Marina - Sales/Leasing
marinas.about: Named the Best and Most Protected Marina on Florida’s Gulf Coast, and consistently awarded Florida’s Clean Marina Certificate year after year, Riviera Dunes Marina offers secure and quality service that is second to none. Rest easy knowing your vessel is safe in our deep water cove, while enjoying all the extravagant luxuries included at the premier Bradenton area marina. Our knowledgeable marina and office staff are always happy to help. Whether it’s arranging the proper slip to fit your preferences, or helping you tie up upon your arrival, Riviera Dunes aims to please. Meet our wonderful staff, and then call to book your slip with us!

marinas.name: Marina At Factory Bay
marinas.address: 1081 Bald Eagle Dr, Marco Island, FL 34145-2130
marinas.about: Marina is situated in Old Marco historical area. Dining is within 1/2 mile north or south. Shopping and town center is 1 mile away. There is uber/cab service on the island and a bike shop next door that rents bikes, golf carts, scooters, etc.

marinas.name: Metropolitan Park Marina
marinas.about: The 78 slips in Metropolitan Park Marina can accommodate boats up to 80 feet LOA and a few very large yachts. The slips are available to the public, first-come, first-served. Reservations are not required except during special events such as Jaguar and college football games at Everbank Field or concerts and festivals in Metropolitan Park.

marinas.name: Port Salerno Marine
marinas.about: Whether you're coming by water, truck or trailer, we've got your vessel covered. When you bring your boat in, you're free to buy your materials wherever you'd like- including discount suppliers. By being able to shop around and choose where to purchase your products, you save hundreds of dollars off traditional boatyard prices. You're also welcome to bring in outside contractors to assist you with your work, and we do not charge a commission fee for the work they do in the boatyard.

marinas.name: Highbanks Marina
marinas.about: What is Highbanks Marina and Campresort? It is a 25 acre, beautifully wooded RV Campground nestled along 2300 feet of the historic St. Johns River on the western edge of Volusia County, Florida. It is also known as the "Camelot on the River". Among the amenities is a 30' x 60' swimming pool, a 3000 square foot clubhouse, pool room, 2 laundries, a well stocked "Country Store", which is a ship's store with ample live bait and various fishing tackle items, a gift shop with hats, t-shirts, umbrellas and much much more. Also, there is a well stocked 1 acre small fry fishing pond for kids 12 years old or 65 years young, 2 horseshoe pits, and a 72 slip boat marina with a gasoline dock and security lights.

marinas.name: Roscioli Yachting Center
marinas.address: 3201 W State Road 84, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33312
marinas.about: Bob Roscioli started his career in the marine industry as an apprentice in 1962. Within a year's time he began to develop the painting technique that would launch his world-renowned marine companies, Donzi by Roscioli International, Inc. and the Roscioli Yachting Center, Inc. Today he applies his vast experience, technical knowledge, and unparalleled standard of excellence into all facets of custom yacht building and yacht maintenance. Bob sets the benchmark for quality. He personally checks each project, step-by-step, to ensure that only the highest standard of quality and craftsmanship is maintained or surpassed. As of today, the entire Roscioli family works together at the Roscioli Yachting Center. Mrs. Roscioli works side-by-side with Bob Roscioli as well as their children, Heather and Robert Jr. The tradition continues on and the Legacy prevails.

marinas.name: Titusville Municipal Marina
marinas.about: PLEASE NOTE: If you would like to stay with us for longer than one month - please use the "General Inquiry" form on our Dockwa page to request and we will get back to you. Please include the length of time you are looking to stay. PLEASE NOTE: BOAT US DISCOUNTS ARE ONLY AVAILABLE FOR NIGHTLY RESERVATIONS, NOT WEEKLY OR MONTHLY. THANK YOU. FUEL!, FUEL!, FUEL! We carry Valv-Tect Diesel and Gas, 89/90 Octane, Non-Ethanol. Stay for a day, a week, or longer. Check out "The Dock Box" our ship store.

marinas.name: The Boat House & Coral Lagoon Resort
PORT 32 Tampa
marinas.about: PORT 32 Tampa’s goal is to enhance your boating experience. PORT 32 customers are able to avoid the long lines at boat ramps, boat ramp fees, and the need to own large tow vehicles. You can call ahead and have your vessel placed in the water, fueled and ready to go with drinks and ice in the cooler. When finished you need only leave the boat at the dock, and our staff will wash it down, flush the engine, and return your boat to its secure, weatherproof storage space. PORT 32 is your valet on the water, taking the hassle out of boating.

marinas.name: Fort Pierce City Marina
marinas.about: The Fort Pierce City Marina features a state of the art dock system, located on Florida’s Treasure coast in historic downtown Fort Pierce, and is a short distance from the Bahamas. Established in 1938, the marina stands the test of time and continues to improve with its, first in the state, Eco-friendly, Storm Protection System and improved yacht friendly navigation. The Marina provides all the amenities of home including free Wi-Fi. Centrally located downtown, we are within walking distance of the library, shops, galleries, restaurants, theater, museums, parks, events and home to many fishing tournaments year round. The Fort Pierce inlet has been labeled the best “all weather inlet on the east coast.” The Inlet and surrounding Indian River Lagoon provide easy access to the Atlantic, many spoil islands for day trips, BBQs, diving/snorkeling, kayaking and world class fishing. A new entrance channel located 1/8th mile South of the South Bridge. Contact us on VHF radio channels 16 and 09.

marinas.name: Astor Landing RV Resort & Marina
marinas.about: Astor Landing campground and marina is located in the heart of Central Florida on the banks of the St. Johns River, surrounded by the Ocala National Forest, in the quiet community of Astor. Astor landing is the perfect place to enjoy the natural Florida. We are minutes from crystal clear springs, wildlife preserves, excellent fishing and hunting, numerous parks and trails and many cultural and historical exhibits. Our Central Florida location is also convenient to many of Florida's popular destinations including: Ocala - Silver Springs Daytona Beach - Daytona International Speedway Orlando - Walt Disney World, Sea World, Universal Studios St. Augustine Our facilities include a campground with full hook-ups, boat docks with water, sewer and electric, a boat ramp on the St. Johns River, a boat and RV storage yard, and a bath house with hot showers.

marinas.name: Windward at Camachee Cove Yacht Harbor
marinas.about: Camachee Cove Yacht Harbor, located in scenic St. Augustine, Florida, offers premier boating amenities and services. With direct access to the Atlantic Ocean and the Intracoastal Waterway, our harbor provides both wet slips and lift slip options, ensuring safekeeping for your vessel. Our knowledgeable staff is dedicated to assisting with all your boating needs. Our on-site amenities include waterfront dining and close proximity to historic St. Augustine attractions. Discover the ultimate waterfront experience with convenience at Camachee Cove Yacht Harbor.

marinas.name: Halifax Sailing Association
marinas.about: "A Tradition of Sailing Excellence" is not only the Halifax Sailing Association's motto, but a fitting description for a club that has dedicated itself to promoting the sport of sailing and perpetuating the values of camaraderie and community. In 1957, twelve sailors organized what was to formally become the Halifax Sailing Association. They had vision, determination and passion. Their intent: "To find a better way to attract more boats, more sailors, and to organize better races and other sailing events." This continues to be a tradition we have upheld for over 50 years. HSA is one of the oldest and most active sailing clubs in Central Florida. In keeping with the Club's original purpose, we sponsor many races and other sailing activities and provide opportunities to introduce both children and adults to this relaxing sport year after year. We also provide affordable sailing lessons so new sailors can learn to sail the correct way, from experienced, certified instructors. Our facility

marinas.name: Safe Harbor Islamorada
marinas.about: Safe Harbor Islamorada provides protected dockage for boaters. With easy access to Yellow Shark Channel, boaters can explore backcountry waters with ideal fly and light tackle fishing. The marina also provides ease of access to world class blue water sport fishing. Safe Harbor Islamorada delights boaters with its convenient and safe location to stay while exploring The Florida Keys has to offer!

marinas.name: The Galleon Marina
marinas.about: Welcome to the Galleon Marina in Key West, Florida! Our premier Florida Keys Marina is located at the luxurious Galleon Resort, just a short walk away from the world famous Duval Street. Our Key West Marina offers dockage space to accommodate boats and yachts up to 155 feet. Outside of being the most highly protected harbor for your vessel, we also offer exclusive marina and resort amenities when renting a boat slip in our Marina. We accept reservations up to one year in advance so start planning your trip to paradise today!

marinas.name: RMK Merrill-Stevens
marinas.about: RMK Merrill-Stevens is a full-service shipyard attracting all sizes and styles of vessels around the world from 30' - 230'. This small but capable restaurant was able to capitalize on the booming American shrimp market from Mayport across the river. The business thrived and created the tradition of serving fresh and local seafood at low costs. This was when Heckscher Drive still had bridges that were made of wood and moved with the tide. After a while, the area demanded a larger facility and in 1988, a new building was constructed by Dwayne Williams, who owned La Cruise Casino and Restaurant in Mayport. He kept the tradition of providing customers with fresh, quality seafood at a low price. Today, under that same direction from the original owner, we look forward to bringing back the same great seafood that The Sandollar brought in when it opened. marinas.name: Crystal River Pete's Pier Marina
marinas.about: Welcome to the largest freshwater Marina in Crystal River. Pete's Pier is the perfect place to launch for all your saltwater adventures! Nestled in the heart of Crystal River is Pete's Pier. Whether you're coming for bait, boat storage, or to view the fresh catch of the day we are the first place you should stop. Our view is priceless with wonderful sunsets, pelicans dawning the waters, and Florida manatees passing our docks daily as they head into the protected springs. For the novice angler, the waters are teeming with Gar, Bass, Specks, Shell Cracker, Mullet, Bluegill, Croaker, Catfish etc., so no one need be disappointed. Instead of traveling around the southern end of the state, boaters can navigate this waterway to travel east–west. This waterway is approximately 154 miles long and stretches from the Atlantic Ocean near Stuart, Florida to the Gulf of Mexico in Fort Myers. It is the only river and canal system in Florida that joins the east coast to the west coast. You are in for a pleasant and unusual trip through the heart of Old Florida. It goes through miles of untouched Florida Everglades and through beautiful ranch land. You will get to see amazing sites and nature’s beauty.

You may even see manatee (sea cows) grazing on the grasses along the river's shore. The natural lush landscape is home to a great variety of exotic birds such as the blue heron, osprey, eagles, hawks and owls. Relax and see the wonders of Florida's back country from the deck of one of our luxurious houseboats. See live alligators basking in the sun in their natural habitat. Explore our warm water springs where the endangered manatee spend winters in the crystal clear 72 degree water. marinas.name: Bradford Marine
marinas.about: Bradford Marine, Fort Lauderdale, is one of the world’s largest in-water, undercover facilities. Our covered slips can handle vessels up to 180 feet. Our 11,000 linear feet of slips and service bays means that whatever the weather’s doing, Bradford Marine can always deliver its repairs on time, as well as provide customers covered storage while their vessels are being repaired. The entire Bradford Marine organization’s commitment to excellence along with its impressive facilities in Fort Lauderdale and Freeport offer customers the finest in quality and service for yacht repair and refit. With over five decades of experience, Bradford Marine is the choice for Yacht Captains and Yacht Owners.

marinas.name: Mangrove Marina
marinas.about: Boatman’s Mangrove Marina is located at 200 Florida Avenue Tavernier, Florida. It is a well-positioned facility situated at Mile Marker 92 on the gulf side. The marina is the largest full service marina in the upper keys and consists of wet slips, dry rack slips, boat ramp, boat launch, fueling facilities, ships store, parts and service bays, laundry, bath house, and working yard. This property is attractive for live-aboard boaters. Off the busy highway and Intracoastal, the marina is quiet and enjoys sunset views. Truly a hidden paradise in the upper Keys. This area is also considered a “hurricane hole” because it is sheltered from hurricanes. The hearty mangrove trees surrounding the marina protect but also provide a quite environment for the live aboard tenants. Full service marina offering live aboard and transient dock slips. We also offer houseboat rentals for a unique "on the water" vacation.

marinas.name: Captain Hiram's Resort
marinas.about: Located along the scenic Indian River in Sebastian, Florida, Capt. Hiram’s Resort Marina is a premier waterfront destination offering top-notch amenities and a laid-back island vibe. Whether you're docking for a night or an extended stay, the marina provides deep-water slips, full hook-ups, and easy access to the Intracoastal Waterway and Atlantic Ocean. Boaters can enjoy pump-out services and a well-equipped ship store, while guests have access to waterside dining, live music, and a tropical-style sandbar. Perfect for fishing enthusiasts, weekend cruisers, and long-term travelers, Capt. Hiram’s Marina combines comfort, convenience, and adventure all in a stunning riverside setting. Experience the best of Florida’s boating lifestyle at Capt. Hiram’s Resort Marina, where every day feels like a vacation!

marinas.name: Boat Tree Marina
marinas.about: Why Boat Tree Marina Is Special Whether you’re stopping in for our Valv-Tect ethanol free fuel, or searching for a marina to call home, Boat Tree offers an experience unlike any other in Central Florida. As the region’s largest full-service marina, we combine unmatched space, top-tier amenities, and on-water expertise to serve you. Most slips are fully equipped with 20/30/50-amp power, water, and pump-out service, making convenience standard—not an upgrade. Our capabilities extend well beyond the dock. As an authorized Yamaha, Suzuki, and Volvo Penta dealer, we provide trusted marine service and support, complemented by a 40,000-lb travel lift for serious maintenance and storage needs. Looking to buy or sell a boat? Boat Tree Marina also offers new Crest Pontoons, used boat sales, and consignment services, making us a true one-stop destination on the water.

Best of all, the marina is just minutes from the Atlantic Ocean with the opportunity to enjoy South Florida’s world-class, deep-sea sportfishing.
